title: 第四章　解读未来之书

zh: 第四章　解读未来之书
en: 4 Reading the Book of the Future

zh: 我们已经进入这样一个世界：非凡的财富从未来索取，然后由后来者的生计来偿还。与此同时，当下大多数人的收入背负着偿还先前索取之成本的负担。这种跨时间获取收入的方式，并不是我们社会和经济生活标准图景的一部分。那幅图景围绕着一个不同的对象组织起来。我们想象自己当下通过一种我们称之为“经济”的安排相互联系。经济并不只是一种虚构，因为它对我们的生活方式产生真实影响。事实上，经济观念是资本托词的拱心石，它产生了对与未来关系的另一种理解。它掩盖了以未来为代价的生活方式。
en: We have come to inhabit a world in which extraordinary wealth is claimed from the future, then repaid from the livelihoods of those who come later. Meanwhile, the earnings of most people in the present carry the burden of repaying the cost of previous claims. This mode of capturing income across time is not part of the standard picture of our social and economic lives. That picture is organised around a different object. We imagine ourselves to be connected in the present by an arrangement that we name ‘the economy’. The economy is not a mere fiction, for it has real effects on the way we live. In fact, the idea of the economy is a keystone of the alibi of capital, producing a different understanding of relations to the future. It obscures the mode of living at the future’s expense.

zh: 我们在过去三章中探索的那些世界，早于“这个经济整体”（the economy）这一观念的出现。当代的经济观念只能追溯到二十世纪中叶。虽然这个词本身古老得多，但直到第二次世界大战爆发前的几年，经济学家才开始把“

经济整体”（the economy）本身视为一个对象。在两次世界大战之间，统计学家已经发展出估算价格、收入、购买和储蓄总量的方法。与此同时，经济学家设计出一种图式，把这些总量描绘成一个整体的各个部分。为了使这些数字显得构成一个对象——一个由相互作用的部分组成的独立结构——该图式必须估算各种总量，包括产品、企业、家庭、收入等等。但它也必须确定——正如我们将看到的——如何掩盖以未来为代价的生活成本，为我们的贫困化方式提供托词。到 1950 年代，这个整体开始被习惯性地描述为“
经济”。在接下来的几十年里，在西方工业化国家（但不一定在其他地方），经济成为政治的中心对象。
en: The worlds we have been exploring in the last three chapters precede the emergence of ‘the economy’. The contemporary idea of the economy dates only from the mid-twentieth century. While the term itself is much older, only in the years just before the Second World War did economists begin to refer to ‘

economy’ as an object in itself. In the interwar period, statisticians had developed methods of estimating aggregate levels of prices, incomes, purchasing, and savings. Meanwhile, economists devised a schema that pictured these aggregates as parts of a whole. To make the numbers appear to form an object – a freestanding structure of interacting parts – the schema had to estimate various totals, for products, firms, households, incomes, and more. But it also had to determine, as we will see, how to disguise the cost of living at the expense of the future, providing an alibi for our modes of impoverishment. By the 1950s, this whole came to be described routinely as ‘the
economy’. Over the following decades, in the industrialised countries of the West but not necessarily elsewhere, the economy became the central object of politics.

zh: 在了解到经济作为独立对象的出现是多么晚近之后，大多数学者忽视了其发明的意义，继续把经济概念投射到更早的时期。这个词被非历史地使用，尤其是在历史学家当中，作为一个可以适用于任何时期的抽象概念，例如在讨论中世纪经济或古埃及经济时。既然更早的社会从事农业、制造商品、发展商业关系、创造信用并征收赋税，那么可以肯定地说它们拥有经济吧？
en: On learning how recently the economy emerged as an object in itself, most scholars ignore the significance of its invention and continue to project the concept of the economy onto earlier periods. The term is used ahistorically, especially among historians, as an abstraction that can apply to any period, as in discussions of the medieval economy or the economy of Ancient Egypt. Since older societies engaged in agriculture, manufactured goods, developed commercial relations, created credit, and levied taxes, surely, they can be said to have had an economy?

zh: 人们可以对这一观念采取那种态度，但没有必要这么做。前面几章探讨了几个世纪的货币、商业和物质生活史，却从未提到一种叫做“经济”的东西。这些章节避免使用这个词，因为它的非历史使用是有代价的。
en: One can take that approach to the idea, but there is no need to do so. The previous chapters have explored several centuries of the history of money, commerce, and material life without once referring to something called ‘the economy’. The chapters avoided the term because its ahistorical use comes at a cost.

zh: 气候崩溃以及对地球系统和共同未来的其他威胁，要求我们放松“经济”对我们思想和行动方式的控制。近几十年来，经济推理和经济的需要，为未能充分应对这些威胁提供了最有力的理由。要对抗关于经济的论点和假设的力量，我们必须追问：这个二十世纪的实体是如何组织起来的，它如今如何支配我们，又如何塑造我们与未来的关系。这些问题将在下一章更充分地讨论，并在本书结尾再次讨论。但如果我们不先追问——正如本章所要做的——在经济被发明之前，财富、改善、对他人的义务和福祉是如何被治理和理解的，那么回答这些问题将更加困难。
en: Climate breakdown and other threats to Earth systems and collective futures require us to loosen the hold of ‘the economy’ over the way we think and act. In recent decades, economic reasoning and the needs of the economy have provided the most powerful justifications for failing to adequately address those threats. To counter the force of arguments and assumptions about the economy, we must ask how this twentieth-century entity was organised, how it governs us in the present, and how it shapes our relationship to the future. Those questions will be taken up more fully in the next chapter and again at the end of the book. But answering them will be more difficult if we do not first ask, as this chapter sets out to do, how wealth, improvement, obligation to others, and well-being were governed and understood prior to the invention of the economy.

zh: 任何人类集体用来安排其生活形式、确立责任和义务的语言，都是构成这些生活形式的一部分——即使语言从未完全把握它所指称的世界。忽视一个集体生活赖以被理解的关键词，把另一个时代的术语当作普遍概念或普遍现代概念强加进来，就无法恰当理解那种生活。虽然这对所有语言和所有人类社会性形式都适用，但对经济学的语言尤其切题。正如最近几项研究所表明的，经济科学的方法是述行性的。也就是说，它力图使自己所描述的图式成为现实，并优化它们或
使它们更有效。
虽然几乎任何科学都可以被证明与其对象有这种双向关系——力图把世界变成一个其模型或解释能够繁盛的地方——经济学在试图格式化其对象即经济方面发挥着显著作用。其原因部分在于经济学的计算性质，作为一门旨在为行动者和机构提供更好确定行动方针之手段的科学。原因还在于经济学与其他科学相比在辩护中的特殊作用——解释集体世界
如此存在。
en: The language that any human collective employs to order its forms of life and establish duties and obligations is part of what constitutes those forms – even if language never fully apprehends the worlds it designates. Ignoring the key words in which a collective life is grasped and imposing terms from another age, treated as universal concepts, or universally modern concepts, fails to properly understand that life. While this is true of all language and all forms of human sociality, it acquires a special pertinence with the language of economics. The method of economic science, as several recent studies have shown, is performative. That is, it seeks to bring into being, and to optimise or
make more effective, the schemas that it describes.

While almost any science can be shown to have this two-way relation with its object, seeking to make of the world a place where its models or explanations can thrive, economics plays a marked role in attempting to format its object, the economy. The reasons for this lie partly in the calculative nature of economics, as a science oriented towards equipping agents and agencies with the means to better determine courses of action. They also lie in the special role that economics plays, compared with other sciences, in justification – in explaining
the collective world exists as it does.

zh: 辩护的运作不仅通过为事物现状提供具体理由，还通过确立一种自然秩序。经济学把经济自然化为其对象，并假定自利是天赋的、通过经济作为一种根本秩序原则发挥作用，其运作方式类似于宗教实践在近代早期的角色。宗教哲学家使用“神义论”一词，指宗教话语在使世界上存在苦难和恶合理化方面的作用，尽管存在着全能和仁慈的神。可以说，经济话语执行着类似的操作，预设一种自然秩序即经济的存在，其交换过程趋向和谐。约瑟夫·福格尔借用希腊词
（经济一词
最初由此派生）提议，把经济学的这种操作称为“经济义论”（oikodicy）。
这里的类比并非意在暗示经济学今天取代了宗教。事实上，“宗教”概念在西方出现的时间，与本章将要探讨的关于“经济”的观念相同，而且确实属于对辩护模式的同一重组过程。
相反，它意在提示，“宗教”和“经济”的共同生产促成了经济学在辩护苦难方面未被承认的作用。
en: Justification operates not only by offering specific reasons for the way things are, but by establishing a natural order. In naturalising the economy as its object, and assuming that self-interest is innate and works through the economy as a fundamental principle of order, economics operates in a manner analogous to the early modern role of religious practice. Philosophers of religion use the term ‘theodicy’ to refer to the role of religious discourse in rationalising the presence of suffering and evil in the world, despite the existence of an allpowerful and benevolent deity. Economic discourse can be said to perform an analogous operation, positing the existence of a natural order, the economy, whose processes of exchange tend towards harmonisation. Drawing on the Greek term
, from which the word economy (
) was originally derived, Joseph Vogl suggests we refer to this operation of economics as ‘oikodicy’.

The analogy is not intended to imply here that economics operates today as a replacement for religion. In fact, the concept of ‘religion’ emerged in the West in the same period as the ideas about ‘economy’ to be explored in this chapter, and, indeed, as part of the same reordering of modes of justification.
Rather, it is to suggest that the coproduction of ‘religion’ and ‘economy’ facilitated the unacknowledged role of economics in the justification of suffering.

zh: 使用经济概念来理解这个词在二十世纪中叶被发明之前的世界，还有另一种代价。正如我们将看到的，经济学的语言似乎通过未来来论述当下。它诊断当前状况，以提供关于事物走向的预测。撇开它做这件事有多成功、以及它如何导致我们误解自己与未来的关系这一问题，这种预测性、面向未来、非历史的经济推理方式还掩盖了这种思维模式的另一个后果：它帮助生产了过去。也就是说，它把当下框定为一般原则的结果——例如物质需求、
自利、技术发展和增长动力——而这些原则始终具有决定作用。
en: There is another cost to using the concept of the economy to understand worlds prior to the invention of the term in the mid-twentieth century. As we will see, the language of economics appears to address the present in relation to the future. It diagnoses current conditions to offer predictions about where things are headed. Leaving aside the issue of how successfully it does this, and, indeed, how it causes us to misapprehend our relation to the future, the predictive, future-oriented, ahistorical mode of economic reasoning conceals another consequence of this mode of thought: it helps produce the past. That is, it frames the present as the outcome of general principles, such as material needs,
self-interest, the development of technology, and the dynamic of growth, that are always determining.

zh: 把经济这样的概念当作适用于所有时代、甚至只适用于被称为资本主义现代性的时代，会制造一种虚假的连续性。关于富足与苦难、改善与衰落、美德与自利、自然与社会、法律与政府的思想史，其令人惊讶之处之一，就是突然断裂出现得如此频繁——即使只在过去两个世纪里——早先的理解形式被抛弃。
en: Taking a concept like the economy as applicable to all times, or even just to the era known as capitalist modernity, creates a false continuity. One of the surprising things about the history of ideas about opulence and suffering, improvement and decline, virtue and self-interest, nature and society, and law and government is the frequency of sudden breaks, even over just the last two centuries, in which earlier forms of understanding were abandoned.

zh: 这种不连续性具有特殊意义。突然的转变和中断——新的知识对象和辩护语言在其中出现——告诉我们一些关于以未来为代价生活的过程。攫取未来总是伴随着不确定性和脱位、危机的时刻。这些脱位可以部分地通过集体生活赖以被理解、组织和辩护的知识形式之突然变化来追踪。在过去一个世纪里，人们采用一套统一的“经济”和“经济的”概念语言，以及关于其治理和“增长”的语言，并把它投射回十九世纪及更早时期；这样一来，从未来抽取所固有的政治不确定性和不稳定性，就被一种观念的连续性遮掩了。
en: This discontinuity has a special significance. The sudden shifts and interruptions, in which a new object of knowledge and language of justification emerge, tell us something about the process of living at the expense of the future. Capturing the future is always open to uncertainty and moments of dislocation and crisis. These dislocations can be tracked, in part, in the abruptly changing forms of knowledge through which collective life is comprehended, organised, and justified. By adopting over the last century a uniform conceptual language of ‘the economy’ and ‘the economic’, and of its government and its ‘growth’, projected back onto the nineteenth century and earlier, the very political uncertainty and instability of extracting from the future is papered over in a continuity of conceptions.

zh: 不仅如此，十九世纪政治经济学的写作和二十世纪经济学的写作，在力图管理这种不连续性方面发挥了决定性作用。从 1824 年 J. R. 麦克库洛赫的

children: 《论政治经济学的兴起、进步、特殊对象与重要性》

zh: 开始，每一部关于财富、改善和物质进步问题的重要著作，都把自己呈现为对先前著作的发展、澄清和批判。先前著作被描绘成同一种关于世界的知识形式的不成熟、不完善的版本。政治经济学和经济学的教学与写作，在遮蔽思想的不连续性和生活形式的脱位方面发挥了作用。
en: More than that, the writing of political economy in the nineteenth century, and of economics in the twentieth century, played a decisive role in attempting to manage this discontinuity. Starting in 1824 with J. R. McCulloch’s

children: Discourse on the Rise, Progress, Peculiar Objects and Importance of Political Economy

en: , every significant text on questions of wealth, improvement, and material progress presented itself as the development, clarification, and critique of earlier writings. Earlier writings were portrayed as simply immature and imperfect versions of the same form of knowledge about the world. The teaching and writing of political economy and economics played a role in occluding the discontinuities in thought and dislocations in forms of life.

zh: 需要考虑四个问题，才能把这些不连续性纳入视野，并把它们与本书其他章节所探讨的更广泛脱位联系起来。第一，在economy一词指称
经济整体之前，它是如何被使用的？那些用法又如何反复变化？答案将依赖于不把过程与事物混为一谈。第二，即使可以表明经济只是在二十世纪中叶才被发明，为什么不把它的发明主要视为词汇的变化？十九世纪——如果不是更早的话——

难道不是已经出现了一个独特的“经济”领域吗？这个新领域难道不是一门新科学即政治经济学的对象吗？事实上，有人会声称，“经济的”与“政治的”的分离本身，正是现代资本主义社会获取财富和安排集体生活的方式区别于较早模式之处——“经济的”标示了一种独特的资本主义权力行使方式。这里的答案将取决于不把重组世界的不完整过程与已完成的结构混淆——事实上，取决于把一种结构化效果理解为一种由其无法完成来定义的过程，而且确实由对其任何描述的不完整性来定义。第三，如果我们承认经济可能只是在二十世纪中叶才被发明，那么是什么导致了它的发明？在它被创造之前，十九世纪末和二十世纪初发生了哪些动荡？既然这一时期恰逢现代经济学学科的形成，那么该学科的对象是什么？为什么到两次世界大战之间它似乎失败了？最后，进入两次世界大战之间的岁月，经济概念最初是作为对哪些紧迫问题的回答而出现的？
en: There are four questions to consider to bring these discontinuities into view and connect them with wider dislocations explored in other chapters of this book. First, how was the term economy used before it referred to

economy and how did those uses repeatedly change? The answer will rely on not confusing a process with a thing. Second, even if it can be shown that the economy was invented only in the midtwentieth century, why not see its invention as mainly a change in vocabulary? Surely there had already emerged in the nineteenth century,

if not earlier, a distinct sphere of ‘the economic’? Was this new sphere not the object of a new science, political economy? In fact, some would claim that the very separation of ‘the economic’ from ‘the political’ is what distinguishes the organisation of modern capitalist societies from earlier modes of acquiring wealth and ordering collective life – that ‘the economic’ designated a distinctively capitalist mode of exercising power. The answer here will depend on not confusing an incomplete process of restructuring the world with an accomplished structure – in fact on understanding a structuring effect as a process defined by the impossibility of its completion; and, indeed, by the incompleteness of any description of it. Third, if we acknowledge that the economy may have been invented only in the mid-twentieth century, what led to its invention? What upheavals in the late nineteenth and early twentieth century preceded its creation? Since that period coincides with the formation of the modern academic discipline of economics, what was the object of that discipline and why by the interwar period did it appear to have failed? Finally, moving into the interwar years, to what immediate problems did the concept of the economy first emerge as an answer?

zh: 政治经济学已死
en: Political Economy Lies Dead

zh: 在
经济整体被发明之前，economy一词是如何使用的？较早的政治经济学科学指的是什么？当经济学研究在十九世纪后期作为学术领域出现时，它的对象是什么？
en: How was the word ‘economy’ used prior to the invention of
economy? To what did the older science of political economy refer? And when the study of economics emerged as an academic field, in the later nineteenth century, what was its object?

zh: 在二十世纪中叶之前，经济一词指的是一个过程，而不是一个事物。该词在英语中的较早用法意味着持家、家务管理或资源管理。它可以用于任何有待管理事务的实体，从人体到家庭再到大型农业庄园。正如基思·特赖布指出的，这个词暗示的是管理和保存，而不是获取和贸易。其他语言中也有同源词。例如在奥斯曼世界，从十六世纪起，土耳其语和阿拉伯语中都发展出一种关于家务管理或庄园管理的论述（
，即管理家务的科学）。这门科学借鉴古典阿拉伯作家，是实践哲学的一个分支，提供“维持上层和下层阶级生计的准则”。
到十八世纪中叶，随着法国、英格兰和
普鲁士等中央集权国家发展出增强的暴力手段，得以取代西班牙、葡萄牙、荷兰和奥斯曼的较早帝国，经济一词被赋予新用途。法国、苏格兰和英格兰的作家用它来指支持和反对扩大君主在改善贸易、人口和福利方面作用的论点。最初保留了一些较早的管理含义，新的

经济学话语论述君主追求人民和国家其他生产资源的“经济”或良好治理的义务。大量辩论涉及君主权利或“国家理由”是否应当优先——例如在商业治理中——还是应当受自然正义原则限制的问题。在一个相互竞争的商业国家组成的欧洲，这些国家试图为国家支持的殖民贸易垄断辩护，或扩大这种垄断，政治经济学一词被用来指十七和十八世纪关于商业问题的一组较早文本。这些文本主要关注政府在保护和改善殖民贸易方面的作用，以及这种扩大了的军事化权力所依赖的国内财政制度。
en: Before the mid-twentieth century, the term economy referred to a process, not a thing. Earlier uses of the word in English connoted husbandry, household management, or the administering of resources. It could be used in reference to any entity with affairs to be managed, from the human body to the household and the large agrarian estate. As Keith Tribe notes, the word suggested stewardship and preservation rather than acquisition and trade. Cognate terms were found in other languages. In the Ottoman world, for example, a discourse concerned with household management or the stewardship of an estate (

, or the science of managing the household) developed from the sixteenth century in both Turkish and Arabic. Drawing on classical Arabic authors, the science was a branch of practical philosophy offering ‘guidelines for the sustenance of the upper and lower classes’.
By the mid-eighteenth century, as centralising states like France, England, and

Prussia developed enhanced means of violence that allowed them to displace the older empires of the Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, and Ottomans, the term economy was repurposed. French, Scottish, and English writers used it to refer to arguments for and against expanding the role of the sovereign in the improvement of trade, population, and welfare. Retaining, at first, some of the older sense of stewardship, the new discourse of

economy addressed the duty of the sovereign to pursue the ‘economy’ or good government of the people and of other productive resources of the country. Much of the debate concerned the question of whether sovereign rights, or ‘reasons of state’, should prevail, for example in the government of commerce, or should be limited by principles of natural justice. In a Europe of competing commercial states attempting to justify or expand state-sponsored colonial trading monopolies, the term political economy was adopted to refer to an older set of texts from the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries on the topic of commerce. Their main concern was the role of government in the protection and improvement of colonial trade and the fiscal regime at home on which this expanded, militarised power depended.

zh: “经济”的这一部署不仅可以借助较早的持家和妥善管理观念，还可以借助中世纪和近代早期该概念在神学辩论中的用法。在基督教神学中，“神圣经济”指天意在规范尘世事务中的作用。乔治·阿甘本认为，这种神学遗产在援引天意般的“看不见的手”来规范人类商业时、或在更一般地诉诸自然法时，重新浮现。
一个被称为
（经济学派）的法国作家学派坚持认为，自然或自然法是良好治理原则的来源，并倡导“重农主义”。这个词援引了这种天意自然的统治。
en: This deployment of ‘economy’ could draw upon not only earlier notions of husbandry and proper management, but also medieval and early modern uses of the concept in theological debate. In Christian theology, the ‘divine economy’ referred to the role of providence in regulating earthly affairs. This theological heritage resurfaces, Giorgio Agamben suggests, in the invocation of a providential ‘hidden hand’ in the regulation of human commerce, or in the more general appeal to laws of nature.
One school of French writers, the group known as
, insisted that nature or natural law was the source of the principles of good government and advocated ‘physiocracy’. The term invoked the rule of this providential nature.

zh: 十八世纪关于这些问题最有影响的作家亚当·斯密，是政治经济学的反对者。在
（1776）中，他攻击政治经济学这一观念本身，即认为政治体需要某种经济或“养生法”来改善自身。与法国重农学派一样，他主张自然法而非国家理由应当指导立法者和君主。与他们不同，他拒绝这样一种论点：立法者需要一套政治经济学“体系”，即一套应遵循的规定，以弥补自然法或自然法理学原则在纠正坏政府不良影响方面的失败。他写道，正如人体“自身包含某种未知的
保存原则”，政治体中也一样，“每个人不断为改善自身境况而作出的自然努力，是一种保存原则，能够在许多方面防止和纠正政治经济学的不良影响”。
en: The most influential eighteenth-century writer on these questions, Adam Smith, was an opponent of political economy. In

(1776), he attacked the very idea of political economy, or the view that the political body needs some economy or ‘regimen’ for its improvement. Like the French Physiocrats, he argued that natural law rather than reasons of state should guide legislators and sovereigns. Unlike them, he rejected the argument that legislators needed a ‘system’ of political economy, meaning a set of prescriptions to follow, to compensate for the failure of natural laws, or the principles of natural jurisprudence, to correct for the ill-effects of bad government. Just as the human body ‘contains in itself some unknown principle of

preservation’, he wrote, so in the political body ‘the natural effort which every man is continually making to better his own condition, is a principle of preservation capable of preventing and correcting, in many respects, the bad effects of a political economy’.

zh: 在

问世同一年，英国的一批北美殖民地宣布反抗欧洲商业垄断和殖民统治体系——这一体系正是支持和反对政治经济学辩论的焦点。到十九世纪初，正如我们在上一章所见，大西洋世界、南亚、奥斯曼帝国和欧洲的革命性变化，迫使英国、法国和其他强国开始用扩展了的国内未来攫取方式来补充通过帝国商业进行的资本化。为了应对这个变化了的世界及其所要求的新的辩护方式，政治经济学一词的含义被重新发明。政治经济学成为这样一种话语：它确立的不再是天意规定的良好治理原则，而是人类社会的世俗法则。
en: In the same year that

appeared, a group of Britain’s North American colonies declared a revolt against the system of European commercial monopolies and colonial rule that had been the focus of debates for and against political economy. By the early nineteenth century, as we saw in the last chapter, revolutionary change in the Atlantic world, in South Asia, and in the Ottoman Empire and Europe had forced Britain, France, and other powers to begin supplementing capitalisation through imperial commerce with expanded domestic modes of capturing the future. To address this changed world, and the new modes of justification it demanded, the meaning of the term political economy was reinvented. Political economy became a discourse for establishing not the providentially ordained principles of proper government but the secular laws of human society.

zh: 一门世俗的社会科学似乎需要与“神圣经济”规范人类事务的观念决裂。在英格兰，盘踞于牛津和其他学术中心的圣公会建制派反对教授这样一些学说：它们不从经文、而从科学推导人的行为规则——尤其是一门把自利之恶变成公共美德、把贫穷这一基督教美德变成集体之恶的科学。为了克服这些反对意见，1825 年，富有的伦敦银行家和新教福音派传教士亨利·德拉蒙德在牛津捐资设立了英格兰第一个政治经济学教席。
同为福音派的理查德·惠特利在 1831 年当选该教席，提议放弃“选择得最不幸的”政治经济学一词，因为它不敬神地专注于获取财富，改而使用新名称“交换学”（catallactics），即“交换的科学”。
en: A secular science of society appeared to require a break with the idea of a ‘divine economy’ regulating human affairs. In England, the Anglican establishment, entrenched at Oxford and other centres of learning, opposed the teaching of doctrines that derived rules of human conduct not from scripture but from science – especially a science that turned the vice of self-interest into a public virtue, and the Christian virtue of poverty into a collective vice. To overcome these objections, in 1825, Henry Drummond, a wealthy London banker and Protestant evangelist, endowed the first chair in political economy in England, at Oxford.

A fellow evangelical, Richard Whately, elected to the new chair in 1831, proposed abandoning the ‘most unfortunately chosen’ term political economy, with its ungodly preoccupation with the acquisition of wealth, replacing it with the new name ‘catallactics’, or the ‘science of exchanges’.

zh: 然而，该领域的领军人物——法国作家让—巴蒂斯特·萨伊及其英国追随者约翰·斯图亚特·密尔——决定恢复政治经济学一词，作为这门新科学的名称，将其理解为社会经济科学的一个子领域。（在普鲁士，萨伊的德语译者创造了对应的术语
（国民经济学），它开始取代十八世纪被称为官房学派的德国科学，后者曾指导财政和福利的公共管理。
）这些作家赞同亚当·斯密对旧政治经济学的拒绝，但在很大程度上也拒绝亚当·斯密本人。他们重新使用政治经济学这个名称，不是用来描述君主的义务，也不是
自然法的原则，而是某些“社会法则”。正如密尔所写，这个词指称涉及人“作为渴望占有财富、并能够判断获取该目的之手段相对效力的存在”的法则。
密尔主张，这些社会法则应当取代主权权力。政治经济学被重新定义，指的是不通过君主或立法机构、而通过调节密尔所谓“社会致富”的不变规则来治理。
en: However, the leading figures in the field, the French writer Jean-Baptiste Say and his English follower John Stuart Mill, decided to revive the term political economy as the name of the new science, understood as a subfield of the science of social economy. (In Prussia, Say’s German translator coined the parallel term
, which began to replace the eighteenth-century German science known as cameralism, which had guided the public administration of finance and welfare.

) These writers agreed with Adam Smith’s rejection of the old political economy, but also largely rejected Adam Smith. They repurposed the name political economy to describe not the duties of the sovereign, nor

the principles of natural law, but certain ‘laws of society’. The term designated the laws, as Mill wrote, that concern man ‘as a being who desires to possess wealth, and who is capable of judging of the comparative efficacy of means for obtaining that end’.

These social laws, Mill argued, should take the place of sovereign powers. Political economy was redefined to refer to governing not through the sovereign or legislature but through the unchanging rules that regulated what Mill called ‘the enrichment of society’.

zh: 坚持认为政治经济学的规则如今构成一门世俗科学，实际上并没有消除天意秩序的问题。假定人在追求财富时按照自利原则行动——这是一条科学原则，其运作被视为社会秩序和集体致富的来源——也许消除了对神圣之手的指称；但这种假定仍然作为一种先验真理发挥作用——也许在神的指称被省略后，其作用更加强大。对苦难和恶的辩护仍然建立于一种看不见的原则的运作之上，只不过这种原则如今用世俗科学的语言、而非神圣经文的语言来表达。
en: The insistence that the rules of political economy now formed a secular science did not, in fact, remove the question of a providential order. The assumption that man acted on a principle of self-interest in the pursuit of wealth, a scientific principle whose operation was the source of social order and collective enrichment, may have eliminated the reference to a divine hand; but the assumption still operated as a transcendental truth – perhaps more powerfully so with the reference to the deity elided. The justification of suffering and evil still rested on the work of an unseen principle, albeit one now expressed in the language of secular science rather than sacred scripture.

zh: 与此同时，这种“世俗的形成”本身并不只是世俗化。

确立“经济”的法则，同样也是确立一种新的基督教“宗教”概念，作为政治和社会经济——理性、自利的致富——领域之外的事物的容器。经济与宗教这两个术语相互依赖，各自通过指涉对方获得新的意义和重要性。而通过宗教视角去把握的那个“领域之外”，如今同时是一个私人空间和一个地理—殖民空间。在欧洲，宗教逐渐指一个私人信仰的残余领域。在欧洲之外，随着商人和传教士把注意力从失去的北美殖民地转向北非、埃及和黎凡特的新致富机会，“宗教”概念获得了扩大了的、殖民化的力量。在伊斯兰的土地上——人们认为理性自利尚未在那里支配一切——宗教取代了世俗社会科学的位置。事实上，东方学把宗教观念发展为一个主导概念，它对于理解伊斯兰世界的重要性，正像经济正逐渐对欧洲世界具有的重要性一样。
en: At the same time, this ‘formation of the secular’ was not itself simply secularising.

Establishing the laws of ‘economy’ was equally the establishing of a new Christian concept of ‘religion’, as the container for what lay beyond the realm of political and social economy – of rational, selfinterested enrichment. The terms economy and religion were codependent, each acquiring a novel meaning and import through reference to one another. And the ‘beyond’ to be grasped through the lens of religion was now simultaneously a private and a geographical-colonial space. In Europe, religion was coming to designate a residual realm of private belief. Beyond Europe, as its merchants and missionaries turned their attention from the lost colonies of North America to the new opportunities for enrichment in North Africa, Egypt, and the Levant, the concept of ‘religion’ took on an expanded, colonising force. In the lands of Islam, where rational self-interest, it was thought, did not yet govern, religion took the place of a secular science of society. Indeed, the science of Orientalism elaborated the idea of religion into a master concept, as central to understanding the Islamic world as economy was becoming for the world of Europe.

zh: 正如吉尔·阿尼贾尔所指出的，在这种基督教对东方的关切中心，矗立着“一座特定的东方城市、一片特定的东方土地，以及一种（或两种）特定的宗教”。
在这方面值得指出的是，银行家和福音派传教士亨利·德拉蒙德在
捐资设立牛津政治经济学新领域教席的同时，还创立了一个预言运动，警告基督即将第二次降临。他资助瑞士东方学家约翰·伯克哈特前往埃及和黎凡特旅行，希望让穆斯林皈依基督教。传教努力失败了——伯克哈特皈依了伊斯兰教，并按照自己的要求以穆斯林身份下葬。
更有希望的是，德拉蒙德的运动主张让欧洲犹太人定居巴勒斯坦，为末日做准备。
en: At the centre of this Christian preoccupation with the Orient, as Gil Anidjar notes, there stood ‘one particular Oriental city, one particular Oriental land, and one (or two) particular religion(s)’.
It is useful in this regard to note that the banker and evangelist Henry Drummond,

while endowing the teaching of the new field of political economy at Oxford, simultaneously founded a prophetic movement warning of the imminent Second Coming of Christ. He funded the Swiss Orientalist Johann Burckhardt’s travels to Egypt and the Levant in the hope of converting Muslims to Christianity. The proselytizing effort failed – Burckhardt converted to Islam and was buried at his own request as a Muslim.
More promisingly, Drummond’s movement advocated the settlement of European Jews in Palestine, in preparation for the apocalypse.

zh: 如同它在十八世纪的前身，十九世纪的政治经济学科学寿命短暂——其原因部分与它和东方之间未解决的关系有关。“我们的政治经济学，”英国散文家、银行家沃尔特·白芝浩在 1876 年写道，“在公众心中已死。”
其批评者抱怨，经济法则只是假设性的，以假定人类仅凭自私本能行动为基础，忽视了“作为负责任道德存在的人”。这门科学描述的是一个由自利支配的社会，而自利只在“欧洲某些地区，而且只是在最近”才成为至高力量，即使在那里也不是唯一的人类动机。
因此，它只处理“一个非常有限而独特的世界”。
即使在欧洲，这门科学也无法充分解释工会主义、合作主义等集体安排的兴起，以及日益强大的私有土地所有权和大企业制度。“工资、利润、积累、消费、人口、济贫法、土地制度、合伙、租佃、工会、合作——这些事物涉及伟大的人类本能、需求和制度；而在大多数情况下，它们超出了单纯经济学家的能力范围。”
en: Like its eighteenth-century predecessor, the nineteenth-century science of political economy had a short life – for reasons connected in part with its unresolved relation to the Orient. ‘Our Political Economy’, wrote the English essayist and banker Walter Bagehot in 1876, ‘lies rather dead in the public mind’.

Its critics complained that the laws of economy were hypothetical, based on assuming humans to act only on selfish instincts, ignoring ‘man as a responsible moral being’. The science described a society governed by self-interest, a paramount force ‘only in certain parts of Europe in very recent times’, and not the only human motive even there.
So it dealt only with ‘a very limited and peculiar world’.

Even in Europe, the science could not adequately explain the rise of collective arrangements such as trade unionism and co-operativism, and the increasingly powerful institutions of private land ownership and large business. ‘Wages, profits, accumulation, consumption, population, poor-laws, land-systems, partnership, tenancy, trade-unions, co-operation, these are things which involve the great human instincts, wants, and institutions; and they are for the most part beyond the reach of a mere economist.’

zh: 批评者承认，在特殊情况下，经济法则可能适用。这些例外值得注意。它们往往是“独立于一般制度和习惯”的情境，建立在“临时性”人际关系或努力以及“特殊且高度人为的过程”之上。一位作家列举了以下例子：“公开市场中的价格、通货、汇票、货币惯例、保险、贸易限制以及税收”。
所以，这些法则可能适用于金融市场以及货币兑换、税收和保险等相关领域，也适用于“公开市场”（market overt）。后者是一个法律术语，指经授权的公共市场，一个特殊空间，商品价格在其中公开协商，因而变得可见。
换言之，经济规则似乎与大多数
人的物质生活关系不大——与手艺、专业和大多数其他雇佣关系（其中许多受新的主仆法管辖，这些法律把违反雇佣合同和其他工人“不服从”行为定为犯罪）关系不大，与土地所有权和租佃关系不大，与企业及其客户之间的货物供应关系不大，几乎与每一种物质关系都关系不大。
但是，在专业化且不断扩张的金融世界，以及某些其他不寻常的交换场所中，经济原则可能适用。
en: The critics acknowledged that there could be exceptional circumstances where the laws of economy might apply. These exceptions are interesting to note. They were situations that tended to be ‘independent of general institutions and habits’, resting on ‘temporary’ human relations or efforts and on ‘special and highly artificial processes’. One writer gave the following list of examples: ‘Prices in market overt, currency, bills of exchange, monetary practices, insurance, restrictions on trade, [and] taxation’.

So the laws might apply in financial markets and such related areas as currency exchange, taxation, and insurance, and in ‘market overt’, or open market. The last of these was a legal term for an authorised public market, an exceptional space in which prices for goods are openly negotiated and thus made visible.
In other words, the rules of economy appeared to have little relevance to the majority of

human material life – to crafts, the professions, and most other employment relations (many of which were governed by new master and servant laws, which criminalised the breaking of employment contracts and other worker ‘disobedience’), to land ownership and tenancy, to the supply of goods among businesses and their customers, to almost every kind of material relationship.
But, in the specialised and expanding world of finance, along with certain other uncommon sites of exchange, the principles of economy might apply.

zh: 为什么这些特殊场所和实践似乎适合经济学家的理论化？

英国货币市场的主要作家白芝浩这样解释：它们之所以特殊，是因为它们交易一种标准化的商品，产生可知的价格。例如，证券交易所在一个关键方面“是最简单的市场”，因为“在其中不存在商品物理品质的问题：一张 1858 年的土耳其债券与另一张一样好或一样坏；一张铁路普通股与任何其他普通股完全相同”。相比之下，在其他情况下，“每个样本的品质都不同，每个市场都需要学习判断品质，品质如此之多，等级又如此细微”。经济学家曾试图通过编制统计表来解决确定谷物（此处指小麦）等普通商品“价格”的困难。但统计表无法告诉你价格：“在一百个案例中，你可能会看到‘价格’被相互比较，仿佛它们是同一事物的价格，而事实上它们是不同事物的价格。
的小麦均价就这样不断被比较，但它几乎从来不是任何两年中品质完全相同的小麦的价格。”
en: Why did these exceptional sites and practices seem to lend themselves to the theorising of the economists?

Bagehot, the leading English writer on the money markets, explained it as follows: they are exceptional because they trade a standardised good that generates knowable prices. The stock exchange, for example, in one key respect, ‘is the simplest of markets’, because ‘there is no question in it of the physical quality of commodities: one Turkish bond of 1858 is as good or bad as another; one ordinary share in a railway exactly the same as any other ordinary share’. In other situations, by contrast, ‘each sample differs in quality, and it is a learning in each market to judge of qualities, so many are they, and so fine their gradations’. Economists had tried to solve this difficulty in determining ‘the price’ of an ordinary commodity, such as corn (wheat), by compiling tables of statistics. But tables cannot tell you the price: ‘in a hundred cases you may see “prices” compared as if they were prices of the same thing, when in fact they are prices of different things. The
average of corn is thus compared incessantly, yet it is hardly the price of the same exact quality of corn in any two years.’

zh: 这就是摆脱 1870 年代开始的政治经济学失败的线索，这种失败促成了一门新学科的诞生，它后来被称为“经济学”。这门学科并没有用“经济”这个宽泛术语来界定自己的对象。相反，它作为一个领域产生，放弃了把人作为“渴望占有财富的社会存在”来研究，而把焦点放在这些“特殊且高度人为的过程”上。正如我们在
所指出的，也如白芝浩所确认的，一个关键现象是某一种特定过程的发展：股市。
en: This is the clue to the way out of the failure of political economy that began in the 1870s, leading to the birth of a new discipline, which came to be called ‘economics’. The discipline did not define its object with the broad term ‘the economy’. Rather, it came into being as a field that abandoned the study of man ‘as a social being who desires to possess wealth’ and took as its focus these ‘special and highly artificial processes’. A critical phenomenon, as we noted in
and as Bagehot confirms, was the development of one particular process, the stock market.

zh: 经济学的诞生
en: The Birth of Economics

zh: 虽然股市的特殊作用是新现象，但这并不是知识对象第一次随着一个新的、有界的、有详细记录的场所出现而转移。政治
经济学家及其批评者长期以来一直依赖“有限而独特的世界”，作为他们可以描述“人为”过程、并将其转化为模型的场所，以解释人类不平等和福祉的安排，以及支配和辩护这些安排的自然法或社会法则。
亚当·斯密曾提出，一国财富的增长源于劳动分工的扩大。为了论证这一点，他给出的著名例子很不寻常：一家制造裁缝用大头针的工场中各道独立工序的增加。他从一系列法国记述中借用了这个例证，这些记述主要由法国科学院委托撰写，并收录于狄德罗的
；每篇文本大多基于较早版本，源于当地贸易检查员的报告，回应法国君主记录和规范专门手艺知识的愿望，而制针正是其中的典型例子。
斯密关于操作多样性的论证，部分建立在连续报告中累积的误读之上。然而更值得注意的是，它依赖于一个范例案例的可得性。有详细记录的制针过程形成了一个人为的微观过程，斯密可以从中读出人类物质进步的全部历史。
en: While the unusual role of stock markets was new, this was not the first time that a shift in the object of knowledge had followed the emergence of a novel, circumscribed, and closely documented site. Political

economists and their critics had for a long time relied upon ‘limited and peculiar worlds’ as the places where they might describe ‘artificial’ processes and translate them into models for explaining arrangements of human inequality and well-being and the laws of nature or society that governed and justified them.

Adam Smith had proposed that the increase in a nation’s wealth arose from the increasing division of labour. To make his argument, he famously offered the unusual example of the multiplication of discrete operations in a workshop for the manufacture of dressmakers’ pins. He borrowed the illustration from a series of French accounts, commissioned mainly by the French Academy of Sciences and reproduced in Diderot’s

, each text based largely on earlier versions, originating in reports of local trade inspectors and responding to the desire of the French monarchy to document and regulate specialised craft knowledge, for which pin making served as a paradigmatic example.

Smith’s argument about the multiplicity of operations rested in part on an accumulation of misreadings in successive reports. However, the more interesting fact is that it relied on the availability of an exemplary case. The closely documented making of the pin formed an artificial microprocess in which Smith could read the entire history of human material progress.

zh: 不如制针工场著名，但在塑造

论证方面更重要的，是斯密为其年轻赞助人巴克卢公爵——英国最大的地主之一——提供建议的经历，内容涉及如何“改良”其苏格兰庄园上的 434 个农场。改良的形式包括圈地、修路、排干湿地和清理高地荒原，以便通过拍卖把农场以商业方式出租。这类“改良”案例证明了斯密的一个观点——它比劳动分工对古典政治经济学的论证更为关键——即人类的改善取决于商业关系或和平交换的扩大，以及“土地应当像任何其他商品一样进入商业”。
同样，为了证明支配和辩护劳动、投入资本与地主地租之间收益分配的法则，大卫·李嘉图借鉴了当时关于农场改良实践试验的记述——轮作、排水、施肥、畜牧——这些记述发表在手册和期刊上，其中许多被收录在 1814 年上议院关于《谷物法》的一份报告中。这些关于试验农业的报告是对拿破仑战争引发的粮食危机的回应；正如玛丽·摩根所提示的，它们形成了一个实验室，产生
数字和例子，李嘉图从中构建了一个模型，通过这种新兴的“经济义论”来解释社会各阶级之间财富的不平等分配。
en: Less famous than the pin factory, but more important in shaping the argument of

, was Smith’s experience in advising his young benefactor, the Duke of Buccleuch, one of the largest landowners in Britain, on measures to ‘improve’ the 434 farms on his Scottish estates. Improvement took the form of enclosure, road building, the draining of wetlands, and the clearing of upland heaths, in order to lease the farms commercially by auction. Such cases of ‘improvement’ demonstrated Smith’s point, more critical to the arguments of classical political economy than the division of labour, that human improvement depended on the increase in relations of commerce, or peaceful exchange, and that ‘land should be as much in commerce as any other goods’.

In a similar way, to demonstrate the laws governing and justifying the distribution of gains between labour, invested capital, and landowners’ rent, David Ricardo drew on contemporary accounts of practical experiments in farm improvement – crop rotation, drainage, manuring, animal husbandry – published in pamphlets and journals, many of which were collected in a House of Lords report in 1814 on the Corn Laws. A response to the food crisis brought on by the Napoleonic wars, these reports on experimental farming, as Mary Morgan suggests, formed a laboratory generating
numbers and examples from which Ricardo produced a model explaining, through this emergent ‘oikodicy’, the unequal distribution of wealth among the different classes of society.

zh: 马克思的著作提供了第三个例子，说明这种关系：关于范例场所的报告和试验的流通——往往与对当前威胁和危机的官方调查有关——与政治经济学不断变化的范式的生产之间的关系。在

第一卷中，马克思著名地区分了两种劳动形式，他声称这一区分是他自己的价值理解与较早政治经济学家著作之间的关键差异。尽管他的前辈把一般劳动理解为剩余价值的来源，马克思却主张，劳动如今已被转化为两种类型：特定生产任务的“具体”劳动和“抽象”劳动。蒸汽驱动的工业机器控制了人的身体，使工厂主能够细致控制每个操作的时间，并不断加速商品制造。对加速生产时间的控制提高了雇主所获剩余的相对份额，因为劳动份额被限制在工资支付之内，而工资由维持和再生产劳动者的成本决定。然而更重要的是，这种剩余如今不再以不同种类的具体劳动来衡量，而是以同质的劳动时间单位来衡量。这些单位排除了实际人类劳动的特殊性，显得不是特定个人生产活动的结果，而是一种抽象——一种由“价值”的普遍单位构成的结构。马克思把这种抽象结构或社会生活“形式”命名为“价值形式”。在资本主义生产组织下，资本对劳动的支配通过这种抽象的异己力量运作。
en: The work of Marx provides a third example of this relationship between the circulation of reports and experiments on exemplary sites, often in connection with official investigations into current threats and crises, and the production of the changing paradigms of political economy. In Volume 1 of

, Marx famously made a distinction between two forms of labour, the distinction that he claimed to be the key difference between his own understanding of value and the writing of earlier political economists. Although his predecessors understood labour in general to be a source of surplus value, Marx argued that labour had now been transformed into two kinds, the ‘concrete’ labour of particular productive tasks and ‘abstract’ labour. Industrial machinery, driven by steam power, had taken control of human bodies, allowing factory owners to control minutely the time of each operation and to continuously speed up the making of goods. The control of accelerating production time increased the relative share of the surplus going to employers, as labour’s share was limited to the payment of a wage, determined by the cost of sustaining and reproducing the labourer. More importantly, however, that surplus was now measured not in different kinds of concrete labour, but in homogeneous units of labour time. These units, emptied of the particularity of actual human labour, appeared not as the result of the productive activity of specific individuals but as an abstraction – a structure of universal units of ‘value’. Marx named this abstract structure, or ‘form’ of social life, the ‘value-form’. Under the capitalist organisation of production, the domination of capital over labour operated through the alien power of this abstraction.

zh: 马克思关于劳动“价值”如今如何以同质时间单位衡量、并表现为一种抽象中介或结构的论述，并不是基于他自己对工厂中发生之事的观察。他从阅读大量工厂检查员和医学检查员的报告中得出这一论述，这些人的工作是旨在减轻工业劳动中虐待现象的自由主义改革的成果。改革者急于强调对时间和劳动控制的系统化、无情的增长。因此，“抽象性”部分来自对工厂生活的规范、记录、再现和复制性记述。只有极少数人口在工厂工作。并非所有人都遵循报告以及马克思所依赖的其他资料来源——例如查尔斯·巴贝奇关于
机械化生产组织的研究
（1832），以及安德鲁·尤尔的
（副标题为

children: 《工厂制度的科学、道德和商业经济阐述》

zh: ）——所描述的逻辑。
我们从当时的记述中知道，工厂劳动往往与这些关于“制造业经济”或“工厂制度经济”的描述大不相同（同样，“经济”在这里指有效率的组织）。
但测量、记录、报告和引用工作促成了抽象性的生产。像斯密的模范制针工场以及他和李嘉图的试验农场一样，工厂提供了一个特殊而不寻常的场所，一门科学可以从中发展出来——在这个例子中，抽象化本身不仅成为一种脑力练习，而且成为真实过程，成为社会支配日常机制的一部分。
en: Marx’s account of how the ‘value’ of labour was now measured in homogeneous units of time, appearing as an abstract mediation or structure, was not based on his own observations of what happened in factories. He drew it from reading the proliferating reports of factory inspectors and medical examiners, whose work was the result of liberal reforms intended to ameliorate the abuse of industrial labour. The reformers were keen to emphasise the systematic and relentless increase in the control of time and labour. So, the ‘abstractness’ was partly a result of the regulating, recording, representing, and replicating accounts of factory life. Only a very small part of the population worked in factories. Not all followed the logic described by the reports and by other sources on which Marx relied, such as Charles Babbage’s study of
the organisation of mechanised production,

children: On the Economy of Machinery and Manufactures

en: (1832), and Andrew Ure’s
(subtitled

children: An Exposition of the Scientific, Moral and Commercial Economy of the Factory System

en: We know from contemporary accounts that factory labour was often very different from these descriptions of the ‘economy of manufactures’ or the ‘economy of the factory system’ (again, ‘economy’ refers here to efficient organisation).

But the work of measuring, recording, reporting, and referencing contributed to the production of abstractness. Like Smith’s model pin workshop and his and Ricardo’s experimental farms, the factory provided an exceptional and unusual site from which a science could be developed – in this case, one in which abstracting itself became not just a mental exercise but a real process, part of the daily mechanism of social domination.

zh: 此后政治经济学的消亡和经济学的诞生，也可以置于这种试验和抽象场所不断转移的序列中。正如我们不久将看到的，这一转变使马克思本人在只出版了

第一卷——重点论述工厂生产——之后，在很大程度上放弃了写作政治经济学批判的计划。在十九世纪的最后三分之一时段，另一个范例场所成为观察和关注的焦点，也成为新解释范式的来源。证券交易所和其他货币市场——投资者和投机者在那里以越来越大的数量和频率交易股票、货币和汇票——以类似但更集中的方式运作，创造了另一种抽象形式，或许还可以说，另一种支配方式。它们也允许另一种科学的可能：新兴经济学学术学科的边际效用理论。新学科放弃了研究人类的伟大“需求和制度”，转而研究“价格”，认为价格代表人类需求的规模以及相应供应的商品数量。正如白芝浩所指出的，金融市场的安排产生了商品的统一“品质”、可知价格的同步运动，以及买卖双方的简单识别，每一方都等同于所有其他方。正是股市，而不是工厂受管制的劳动过程，产生了经济学如今可以据以建立的简化、数字化组织的世界。
en: The subsequent demise of political economy and the birth of economics can also be situated in this sequence of shifting locations of experimentation and abstraction. As we will see shortly, the shift caused Marx himself to largely abandon the project of writing a critique of political economy, after publishing just the first volume of

, with its focus on factory production. In the last third of the nineteenth century, another exemplary site became the focus of observation and concern, and the source of a new paradigm of explanation. The stock exchanges and other money markets, where investors and speculators traded in shares, currencies, and bills of exchange at an increasing volume and frequency, operated in a similar yet more focused way, creating another form of abstraction – and, we might add, another mode of domination. They too allowed the possibility of a different science: the marginal utility theory of the emergent academic discipline of economics. Abandoning the study of the great human ‘wants and institutions’, the new discipline substituted the study of ‘prices’, taking them to represent the scale of human wants and the volume of commodities supplied in response. A financial market was arranged to produce, as Bagehot noted, the uniform ‘quality’ of the commodity, a synchronised movement of knowable prices, and the simple identification of buyers and sellers, each one equivalent to all the others. It was the stock market, rather than the regulated labour process of the factory, that generated the simplified, numerically organised world on which economics could now be built.

zh: 科学知识的新微观场所也产生了确立这种知识的更大需要。这种需要源于一个事实：
股票和商品交易所不仅产生了可计量的价格体系，作为一种“实在抽象”，而且产生了反复危机的模式。这些危机与价格体系所建立于其上的过程有关——欧洲日益加紧地试图从非欧洲世界获利并重组它。那个世界开始像幽灵一样出现：一个新科学几乎无法把握的形象，一个既要求又逃避其理解的未知者。
en: The new microsite of scientific knowledge also created an increased need to establish such knowledge. The need arose from the fact that

stock and commodity exchanges produced not just a measurable price system, as a ‘real abstraction’, but a pattern of repeated crisis. The crises were connected with the process on which the price system was constructed – Europe’s intensifying attempt to profit from and reorganise the non-European world. That world began to appear as a spectre: a figure just beyond the grasp of the new science, the unknown that both demanded and escaped its understanding.

zh: 半成形与半文明
en: Half-Finished and Half-Civilised

zh: 因此，还有另一个原因，使股市突然似乎成为理想场所，不仅可以理解通过价格形成而运作的致富机制，还可以理解影响这一过程的危机。货币市场是把价格现象与似乎最应对其不稳定性负责的环境联系起来的场所：正如前几章所指出的，“帝国主义”的新权力。
en: There was thus a further reason why the stock markets suddenly seemed an ideal place to understand, not just the working of mechanisms of enrichment, through the formation of prices, but the crises affecting this process. The money markets were the site that connected the phenomenon of prices to the circumstances that seemed most responsible for their instability: the new powers, as noted in previous chapters, of ‘imperialism’.

zh: 到 1870 年代中期，货币市场陷入动荡。1873 年恐慌是一系列似乎几乎每十年发生一次的金融危机中最严重的一次。
这场危机由北美铁路项目失败以及芝加哥、柏林和维也纳投机性城市开发的崩溃触发（在维也纳，1873 年世界博览会未能迎来预期人潮，导致房地产价值暴跌），摧毁了北美和欧洲的贸易和企业，导致印度卢比价值暴跌，导致伊斯坦布尔和开罗的奥斯曼政府破产（使白芝浩所说的“1858 年土耳其债券”以及为支持它而创造的所有后续贷款价值尽失），并导致英国征服和占领埃及。
en: By the mid-1870s, the money markets were in turmoil. The Panic of 1873 was the worst in a series of financial crises that seemed to occur almost every decade.

Triggered by the failure of North American railway ventures and the collapse of speculative urban development in Chicago, Berlin, and Vienna (where the absence of anticipated crowds at the 1873 World Exhibition caused property values to crash), the crisis destroyed trade and businesses across North America and Europe, caused the value of the Indian rupee to collapse, and led to the bankruptcy of the Ottoman governments in Istanbul and Cairo (destroying the value of Bagehot’s ‘Turkish bond of 1858’ and all the subsequent loans created in its support) and to the British conquest and occupation of Egypt.

zh: 经济学与帝国危机之间的联系，可以在沃尔特·白芝浩的著作中看到。白芝浩写道，有必要更好地理解“商业的事实”，还要理解“大商业”的事实，尤其是与当时“新问题”相关的事实。他集中讨论了两个这样的问题。一是如何理解反复出现的全球金融衰退——似乎以周期性方式折磨货币市场的恐慌和危机。一些作家曾提出对周期性的气象学解释。似乎“太阳状态的变化”遵循规律周期，可以与“地球的总体生产力”联系起来。白芝浩
问道，由此产生的“产业效率的周期性变化”会对商业产生什么影响？那么，太阳变化影响整个地球，因而与“货币市场困难时期的规律性重现有很大关系”，这似乎是可能的，是否属实？
另一个问题是如何理解英国首次向欧洲以外政府提供的大额贷款的影响。正当奥斯曼和埃及政府在向其提供信用的欧洲银行家面前宣告破产时，他使用了这种帝国金融所依赖的种族优越论语言，指出“我们向半成形和半文明的共同体强加不可估量的巨款”。这些共同体几乎可以获得任何数额的信用货币。他补充说，“从来没有初生的文明，也从来没有停滞的文明，曾经拥有这种便利”。
en: The connection between economics and imperial crisis can be seen in the writings of Walter Bagehot. There was a need, Bagehot wrote, to better understand not just ‘the facts of commerce’, but those of ‘the great commerce’, especially in relation to the ‘new problems’ of the time. He focused on two such problems. One was how to understand the repeated, worldwide financial downturns – the panics and crises that seemed to afflict the money markets in cyclical fashion. Some writers had proposed a meteorological explanation for the cycles. It appeared that ‘changes in the state of the sun’ followed regular cycles that could be linked to ‘the general productiveness of the earth’. What effect, Bagehot

asked, would the resulting ‘cyclical variation in the efficiency of industry’ have upon commerce? Was it therefore true, as seemed likely, that the solar variations, affecting the whole Earth, ‘have much to do with the regular recurrence of difficult times in the money market’?

The other problem was how to understand the effect of the large loans England had been making for the first time to governments outside Europe. At the moment when the Ottoman and Egyptian governments were declared bankrupt before the European bankers who had extended credit to them, using the language of racial superiority on which such imperial finance relied, he noted how ‘we press upon half-finished and half-civilised communities incalculable sums’. These communities had been offered credit money in almost any amount. ‘No incipient and no arrested civilisations’, he added, ‘ever had this facility before.’

zh: 这两个需要经济科学来解答的新问题，都源于金融市场。

两者都涉及欧洲与其正在殖民的世界之间的新金融关系。虽然金融不稳定性与帝国主义不稳定性之间的这种联系，在向所谓“半文明”共同体提供银行贷款的案例中十分明显，但如今看来，这种联系也可以解释信用周期。对信用周期性充裕和稀缺最有希望的解释，基于农业——财富的主要来源——与气候之间的关系。气象周期或许可以解释金融危机重现的想法，从十九世纪初起就有人讨论。有人提出，天气变化——也许与太阳活动周期有关——会引起谷物和其他作物价格波动，导致信用可得性和成本的周期。但人们没有发现任何决定性关系。然而在 1870 年代，经济学家威廉·斯坦利·杰文斯提出了可能解释这种关系的统计证据。确实，太阳黑子与欧洲谷物和其他主粮作物价格之间没有相关性。杰文斯提出，这是因为“我们气候的条件太复杂了”。
但信用市场的巨大扰动，可能是欧洲与热带地区贸易扩大所造成的问题。在热带国家，天气逐季变化较小，因此气候不那么复杂。这种稳定性一方面促进了长期信用的创造，另一方面也使这种信用容易受到长期周期性变化的影响，例如与太阳黑子有关的变化。印度贸易大概就是这种情况，“热带非洲、美洲、
西印度群岛，甚至黎凡特，都很可能受到同一种气象影响”。杰文斯声称，太阳黑子导致热带每十年一次的饥荒，因此“正是那些对世界这些地区贸易规模最大、

children: 并向其客户提供长期信用

zh: 的国家，受这些危机之害最深”。
en: Both examples of the new problems for which economic science was needed arose from financial markets.

And both concerned the new financial relations between Europe and the world it was colonising. While this connection between the instability of finance and the instability of imperialism was clear in the case of bank loans extended to so-called ‘half-civilised’ communities, the connection could also, it now seemed, account for credit cycles. The most promising explanation for the cyclical abundance and scarcity of credit was based on the relationship between agriculture – the main source of wealth – and climate. The idea that meteorological cycles might explain the recurrence of financial crises had been discussed since the early nineteenth century. Variations in weather, perhaps associated with cycles of solar activity, it had been proposed, would cause fluctuations in the price of grain and other crops, leading to cycles in the availability and cost of credit. But no conclusive relation had been found. In the 1870s, however, the economist William Stanley Jevons developed statistical evidence that might explain this relationship. It was true that there was no correlation between sunspots and the price of grain and other staple crops in Europe. This was because, Jevons suggested, ‘the conditions of our climate are too complicated’.

But large disturbances in the credit market might be a problem caused by Europe’s expanded trade with the tropics. In tropical countries the weather was less variable from season to season and the climate therefore less complicated. This stability on the one hand facilitated the creation of long-term credit. On the other, it made that credit vulnerable to long-term cyclical variations, such as those associated with sunspots. This was probably the case with the Indian trade, and ‘it is quite possible that tropical Africa, America, the

West Indies, and even the Levant are affected by the same meteorological influence’. Jevons claimed that sunspots caused decennial famines in the tropics, so ‘it is the nations which trade most largely to those parts of the world,

children: and which give long credits to their customers

en: , which suffer most from these crises’.

zh: 如果股市把金融不稳定与帝国主义联系起来，那么会产生一个奇怪的后果。当政治经济学在欧洲似乎已经死去时，它在非欧洲世界却突然复活，并被赋予新用途。这种重新利用促成了资本的另一种托词，即“帝国的托词”。
如果经济学新科学诞生于货币市场的模型空间，那么政治经济学的旧科学也在同一时期带着新目的获得重生。它正成为一种治理这些金融过程受害者的手段，即那些被白芝浩贬称为半成形和半文明的人。到 1880 年代，政治经济学说正被克罗默勋爵等人物复兴为殖民治理的工具；克罗默是英国驻埃及总督，而英国在金融危机把该国统治者推向破产之后占领了埃及。随后发生的事可以被称为“殖民唯物主义”。
殖民统治中的操作性区分不是经济与政治之间的区分，而是物质与道德之间的区分；这两个词不是指社会世界的不同领域，而是指对人类行动的治理。在克罗默看来，埃及农民和所有人一样，天生自利，因此有能力支配自己的
改善。但在其
生活中，他落后了，无法为更高层次的共同善而努力。个人自利与道德落后之间的这一区分，为殖民支配的巨大不公提供了辩护，即经济义论。克罗默在两卷本埃及殖民行政记述中，只以节俭这一常规含义使用 economy 一词。他写道，在英国占领该国的早期，“必须实行最大程度的节俭”。
他只用过几次 economic 一词，而且不是指社会世界的一个领域，而是指治理的规则和问题。他长达 1,200 页的文本触及殖民统治声称带来的物质和道德改善的方方面面，但使用 economy 一词时除了节俭外没有其他含义，使用 economic 时则不是描述物质生活，而是描述政策的道德法则或原则。殖民埃及从来与一个叫做“经济”的对象或“
经济的”领域无关。这种特定的辩护语言，只有在殖民秩序崩溃时才会出现。
en: If the stock markets connected financial instability to imperialism, there was a curious consequence. While, in Europe, political economy seemed to lie dead, in the non-European world, it was suddenly brought back to life and repurposed. The repurposing served the creation of another of the alibis of capital: the ‘alibi of empire’.

If the new science of economics was born out of the model space of the money markets, the old science of political economy was reborn at the same time with a new purpose. It was becoming a means to govern the victims of these financial processes, those disparaged by Bagehot as half-finished and half-civilised. By the 1880s, the doctrines of political economy were being revived as an instrument of colonial government by men like Lord Cromer, the British viceroy in Egypt, the country Britain had occupied after the crisis in the financial markets pushed its ruler into bankruptcy. What followed might be labelled ‘colonial materialism’.

The operative distinction in colonial rule was not between the economic and the political, but between the material and the moral, words that refer not to discrete domains of the social world but to the government of human action. The Egyptian peasant, in Cromer’s view, like all human beings, was naturally self-interested, and therefore capable of governing his own
improvement. But in his

life he was backwards, incapable of working towards a higher, common good. This distinction between individual self-interest and moral backwardness provided the justification, the oikodicy, for the great injustice of colonial domination. In the two-volume account of his colonial administration of Egypt, Cromer used the word economy only with the conventional meaning of parsimony. In the early years of the British occupation of the country, he wrote, ‘the utmost economy had to be practised’.

He used the word ‘economic’ only a handful of times, and in reference not to a realm of the social world but to rules and questions of government. His 1,200-page text touched on every aspect of the material and moral improvement that colonial rule claimed to bring but used the word economy with no meaning other than frugality, and the word economic to characterise not material life but the moral laws or principles of policy. Colonising Egypt was never concerned with an object called ‘the economy’ or a realm of ‘the
economic’. That particular language of justification would emerge only when the colonial order was collapsing.

zh: 在随后考察一个世纪后新自由主义经济思想的章节中，我们将看到新自由主义学说如何在全球南方获得第二重幽灵般的生命，在北方已在很大程度上失去信誉之后，仍作为一种僵尸思想徘徊许久。同样，古老、古典的政治经济学也获得了幽灵般的来世——在埃及，用来治理当地人。在这种情况下，殖民地不是新科学的实验室，而是一门垂死科学的幽灵家园。
en: In a subsequent chapter examining neoliberal economic thought a century later, we will see how the doctrines of neoliberalism acquired a second, spectral life in the Global South, lingering as a kind of zombie thought long after they had been largely discredited in the north. So too the old, classical political economy acquired a ghostly afterlife – in Egypt, to govern natives. The colonies were not in this case a laboratory for a new science, but a spectral home for a dying science.

zh: 与此同时，除了用于日益无关紧要的政治经济学科学名称之外，“经济”一词在英语中继续主要在一种更狭窄的意义上使用。它仍与持家或家务的原始含义相关，但范围更窄，指审慎使用资源或有效率地管理一项事业。马克思
中少数使用“经济”一词的地方之一，出现在一段关于木材生长的文字中，引用了德国一本关于土地经济的便览。该便览作者指出，林业“为了实现其常规经营，需要比谷物种植更大的面积”。
更常见的是，这个词不仅指有效管理，还指节省成本或节俭，例如马克思在后来成为
第三卷的手稿中所说，“在空间，因而也在建筑物等方面作出的大量
，结果把工人挤在狭小的环境中”。
en: Meanwhile, apart from its use in the title of the increasingly irrelevant science of political economy, the word ‘economy’ continued to be used in English mainly in a more restricted sense. Still associated with the original meaning of husbandry or householding, but narrower in scope, the word denoted the prudent use of resources, or the efficient management of an undertaking. One of the rare uses of the term ‘economy’ in Marx’s

occurs in a passage on the growing of timber, quoting from a German handbook on land economy. Forestry, the author of the handbook notes, ‘requires for its regular economy a larger area than grain culture’.
More frequently, the word referred not just to efficient administration but to cost-saving or frugality, as when Marx remarked in the manuscript that later became volume three of
‘how much
on space and therefore on buildings, etc., results in crowding workers together in cramped conditions’.

zh: 正如经济一词持家意义上的原始含义先前曾被借用来指更广泛意义上的良好治理，节俭意义上的经济不仅可以用于具体的审慎和效率行为，还可以用来描述一般政府政策。它指一种更高效、更审慎地使用资源的纲领。
en: Just as the original meaning of the word economy in the sense of husbandry had previously been borrowed to denote the wider idea of good government, economy in the sense of frugality could be used not just for specific acts of prudence and efficiency but to describe government policy in general. It designated a programme of more efficient and prudent use of resources.

zh: 当这种政策在国内被倡导为帝国主义的替代方案时，它可能被称为“
经济”。英国批评克罗默等帝国主义者的主要论者、社会主义作家 J. A. 霍布森这样使用该短语，以推动国内改善纲领。在 1902 年出版的经典论著
中，霍布森主张，帝国强国外部获取海外领土和资源的驱动力——通常涉及战争——可以用国内更有效地使用资源来取代，办法是“用对国民资源的集约经营替代粗放经营”。他总结说，“这样一种国民经济不仅会摧毁战争的主要动机，还会深刻改变
各国政府从事的工业斗争”。
在这类著作中，经济一词和“国民经济”短语指的是对物质资源的有效管理，而不是被管理的对象。
这种用法不应与二十世纪中叶以后用“
国民经济整体”（the national economy）指称这样一种对象的做法相混淆。
前一种用法指一个过程，而不是一个事物。
en: When advocated at home as an alternative to imperialism, such a policy might now be called ‘
economy’. The leading English critic of imperialists like Cromer, the socialist writer J. A. Hobson, used the phrase in this way to promote a programme of domestic improvement. In his classic essay

, published in 1902, Hobson argued that the external drive by imperial powers to acquire territory and resources overseas, usually involving warfare, could be replaced with the more efficient use of resources at home, by ‘substituting an intensive for an extensive economy of national resources’. He concluded that ‘such a national economy would not only destroy the chief motives of war, it would profoundly modify the industrial struggle in which
governments engage’.
The word economy, and the phrase national economy, refer in such writings to an efficient administering of material resources, not to the object being administered.
This usage should not be confused with the later deployment of the phrase ‘
national economy’, from the mid-twentieth century, to denote such an object.
The wording refers to a process, not a thing.

zh: 经济化
en: Economisation

zh: 这类论点忽视了二十世纪经济发明的意义，后面各章将对此进行探讨。
正如我们将看到的，经济“不只是”一种再现，而是一种复杂装置，用来通过其未来治理人口（
），并管理那种未来占有借以进行的种种托词（
）。然而，这些论点也误解了先前发生的事情。这类论点背后是一种关于资本主义社会或资本化社会如何运作的更大观点。正如我们在

所指出的，大多数关于资本主义的历史叙述是演化论的：它们把资本主义的出现归因于商业关系、生产方式、军事力量或人类占有欲的逐渐发展。但另一条源自马克思的思想线索，把资本主义的诞生定位于一种更具断裂性的变化：一个剥夺过程，最早见于近代早期英国，它创造了一个庞大的无土地、无财产人口，这些人依赖向如今控制其生存所需手段的人出卖劳动力。在这种分析中，一旦大多数人依靠向他人出卖劳动力为生，一种新的政治秩序就出现了，它建立在不同的强制安排之上。大多数人别无选择，只能把劳动力卖给有手段购买劳动力的人，后者不仅获得劳动的使用和控制权，还获得劳动产品的所有权。这种重组创造了一种不同的治理人口的方法。以前，有权势者只有在商品生产出来
才能获得对剩余财富的控制。这种获取依赖于建立人身依附关系，而这种关系需要社会辩护、宗教和司法特权以及强制权力。如今，他们通过商品生产的方式本身获取剩余。生产装置——无论是煤矿、麦田还是棉纺厂——成为私有化场所，有权势者在那里组织控制并攫取剩余。
en: Such arguments overlook the significance, to be explored in subsequent chapters, of the twentieth-century invention of the economy.
The economy, as we will see, was not ‘just’ a representation, but a complex device for governing a population through its future (
), and for managing the alibis under which the appropriation of that future proceeded (
). However, they also misunderstand what came before. Underlying such arguments is a larger view of the way a capitalist, or capitalising, society works. As we noted in

, most historical accounts of capitalism are evolutionary: they attribute its emergence to the gradual development of commercial relations, methods of production, military power, or human acquisitiveness. But a different line of thought, drawn from Marx, locates the birth of capitalism in a more disjunctive change: a process of dispossession, first seen in early modern Britain, that created a large landless and propertyless population dependent on selling its labour to those who now controlled the means they required to survive. Once the majority of people depended for their existence on the sale of their labour to others, in this analysis, a new political order emerged, based on a different arrangement of coercion. The majority had no choice but to sell their labour to those with the means to buy it, and the latter acquired not only the use and control of the labour but ownership of what it produced. This reorganisation created a different method of governing populations. Previously, the powerful acquired control of surplus wealth only

goods had been produced. Its acquisition relied upon creating relations of personal dependence that required social justifications, religious and judicial prerogatives, and coercive powers. Now they acquired the surplus through the very way goods were produced. The apparatus of production, whether a coalmine, a corn field, or a cotton mill, became the privatised site where the powerful organised control and captured the surplus.

zh: 让我们暂且搁置这样一个事实：较早形式的商业社会往往允许商人和统治者通过债务和税收义务工具来安排和治理生产。

也让我们暂且搁置另一个事实：今天的大多数人并不受雇于物质生产，而消费、债务、治安和政治强制等形式是剩余攫取装置的重要方面（马克思本人也意识到这一点）。让我们把关于经济及其增长如何成为治理许多人口的最有力抽象之一的解释，推迟到下一章。相反，我们继续关注与工业生产兴起相关的剥夺和强制形式；对这一变化有时会作这样一种简单描述：攫取装置已从政治领域转移到经济领域。这种表述往往意味着政治和经济是超历史范畴，描述所有社会的功能划分。更好的说法或许是：这种安排剩余攫取的方法采取了经济与政治分离这一历史特定形式。
这就是如下论点所指的意思：在资本主义现代性中，经济成为一种
抽象。它不仅是思想中新兴的范畴，而且是一种在集体世界组织中得到实现的抽象。它如何实现？关键要素在于人的劳动成为一种可以买卖的商品。用格奥尔格·卢卡奇的话说，资本主义下的劳动“成为社会的一个范畴，决定性地影响着由此出现的社会中事物和人的客观形式”。
这种劳动生产的产品不是生产者的财产，而是购买劳动使用权者所拥有的商品。一系列私法安排和市场机制——买卖劳动的合同，以及授予个人对土地、劳动力或商品绝对控制权而不论由谁耕种、培育或创造的产权规则——使剩余攫取成为受财产法和市场交换规则管辖的私人安排。
en: Let us leave aside for now the fact that older forms of commercial society often allowed merchants and rulers, through the instruments of debt and tax obligation, to arrange and govern production.

Let us also leave aside for now the fact that most people today are not employed in material production, and that forms of consumption, debt, policing, and political coercion are significant aspects of the apparatuses for the capture of surplus (as Marx himself was aware). Let us hold off, until the next chapter, an explanation of how the economy and its growth became among the most powerful abstractions through which many populations are governed. Staying, instead, with the forms of dispossession and coercion associated with the rise of industrial production, a simple way this change is sometimes described is to say that the apparatus of capture had been relocated from the political realm to the economic. That formulation often implies that the political and the economic are trans-historical categories describing the functional divisions of all societies. A better approach might be to say that this method of arranging the capture of surplus took the historically specific form of a separation of the economic from the political.
This is what is meant by the argument that, in capitalist modernity, the economic becomes a

abstraction. It is not just an emergent category of thought, but an abstraction that is realised in the organising of the collective world. How is it realised? The key element is that human labour becomes a commodity that can be bought and sold. Labour under capitalism, in the words of Georg Lukács, ‘becomes a category of society influencing decisively the objective form of things and people in the society thus emerging’.

The goods produced by that labour are not the property of the producer, but commodities owned by whoever purchases the use of the labour. A series of private legal arrangements and market mechanisms – contracts to buy and sell labour and rules of ownership that award an individual absolute control over land, labour power, or goods irrespective of who cultivates, nurtures, or creates them – render the capture of surplus a private arrangement governed by laws of property and rules of market exchange.

zh: 然而，把这个过程简单描述为“经济的”（以及“劳动”）作为一个实在抽象的创造，似乎简化了实际发生的事。这种抽象化并不是轻易、瞬间或孤立于它所依赖的其他过程而发生的。
我们可以再次提到莫伊舍·波斯通的著作（见
）。波斯通超越卢卡奇，对实在抽象作出了有力分析。如果以时间纪律为基础的工厂生产把劳动变成一种实在抽象，其意义就在于产生“价值”的效果，即按
统一的劳动时间单位来计算。“价值”，波斯通认为，成为似乎决定财富如何分配的抽象尺度。这种尺度、这种抽象使我们误解不平等的来源，并作为一种支配结构运作。
与政治支配的公开制度不同，“经济的”范畴即价值，通过物质生活的日常组织运作。在这个意义上，资本主义依赖于政治与经济的“实在”分离。
en: However, to describe this process simply as the creation of ‘the economic’ (and of ‘labour’) as a real abstraction seems to simplify what occurs. Such abstracting does not happen easily, instantly, or in isolation from other processes on which it depends.
We can refer again to the work of Moishe Postone (see

). Moving beyond Lukács, Postone develops a powerful analysis of real abstraction. If factory production, based on time discipline, turns labour into a real abstraction, its significance lies in producing the effect of ‘value’, counted in

uniform units of labour time. ‘Value’, Postone argues, becomes the abstract measure that appears to determine how wealth is distributed. Causing us to misapprehend the source of inequality, this measure, this abstraction, operates as a structure of domination.

Unlike the overt institutions of political domination, an ‘economic’ category, value, operates through the mundane organisation of material life. In this sense, capitalism depends upon the ‘real’ separation of the political from the economic.

zh: 我们可以接受这一分析，但仍然存在分歧。波斯通描述的是一种抽象，而不是抽象化的过程。生产这种抽象与其说是一次性的历史转变，不如说是每日的重演。要使某种劳动用途或某件商品获得“价值”，并作为“商业”或“市场”现象运作，它必须与其他关系和纠葛分离，例如持家、相互义务、人身依附、国家权力和身体强制。此外，正如卡罗琳·哈丁所提示的，产生支配性抽象的攫取装置，不仅通过工资支付、也通过其他领域运作，例如通过债务关系以及管理自身未来“风险”的强制。虽然这种“通过债务支配”今天可能显得更加普遍，但正如我们在
所论证的，负债的力量内在于工资的运作之中。
en: We can follow this analysis but still be left with a disagreement. Postone describes an abstraction, but not the process of abstracting. Producing the abstraction is not so much a singular historical transformation as a daily reoccurrence. For a particular use of labour or item of merchandise to acquire ‘value’ and operate as a ‘commercial’ or ‘market’ phenomenon, it must be separated from other ties and entanglements, such as those of householding, mutual obligation, personal dependence, state power, and physical coercion. Furthermore, as Carolyn Hardin suggests, the apparatuses of capture producing governing abstractions operate through spheres other than the payment of the wage, for example through relations of debt and the compulsion to manage ‘risks’ to one’s future. While such ‘governing by debt’ may appear more prevalent today, the force of indebtedness was, as we argued in
, internal to the operation of the wage.

zh: 我们可以在另一位学者的著作中看到把握“经济的”这一困难；这位学者更多地与“经济的”在十九世纪作为一个独立领域出现的观念联系在一起，即卡尔·波兰尼。很长一段时间里，波兰尼的经典著作
（1944）被误读为一部关于十九世纪“经济”从社会中脱嵌的记述。这本书并没有这样说；它的论证构思于 1930 年代，当时“经济”观念尚未真正出现。它或许促成了这种观念的出现，尤其是在 1950 年代以后，波兰尼及其追随者用那个十年新颖的语言重述其论证，把它变成了一部关于十九世纪“经济”脱嵌的记述。
这本书本身是一个关于“市场关系”或“市场社会”的论证，描述十九世纪的“市场”如何被构造成一种从互惠、义务和道德论证的纽带中脱嵌的制度——这些纽带先前曾约束市场。（这是针对弗里德里希·哈耶克等新自由主义先驱奥地利人的论证，我们将在本章结尾回到他们。）然而，脱嵌是一个误导性的术语。
en: We can see this difficulty of grasping ‘the economic’ in the work of another scholar, one more widely associated with the idea of the emergence of the ‘economic’ as a separate sphere in the nineteenth century, Karl Polanyi. For a long while, Polanyi’s classic work

(1944) was misread as an account of the nineteenth-century disembedding of ‘the economy’ from society. This was not what the book said; its argument was conceived in the 1930s, before the idea of ‘the economy’ had properly emerged. It perhaps contributed towards its emergence, especially after Polanyi and his followers, from the 1950s, restated its argument in the novel language of that decade as an account of the nineteenth-century disembedding of ‘the economy’.

The book itself was an argument about ‘market relations’ or ‘market society’, describing how ‘the market’ in the nineteenth century was formulated as an institution disembedded from the ties of reciprocity, obligation, and moral argument that had previously contained it. (It was an argument against men like Friedrich Hayek and other Austrians, the pioneers of neoliberalism, to whom we will turn at the end of this chapter.) However, disembedding is a misleading term.

zh: 一方面，正如波兰尼本人所阐明的，“市场社会”从未成功摆脱那些纠葛。家庭住户、政治权威、身体强制和社会义务都被重组，以支持、执行或补偿新财产法和合同法的运作。另一方面，经济脱嵌的观念假定经济市场作为一种抽象空间存在，其中已经充满买者、卖者和商品。正如米歇尔·卡隆所指出的，这一概念往往忽视为了把劳动、资本或商品“嵌入”市场交换关系而必须进行的持续工作。事实上，要把某个行动主体构成为买者、把另一个构成为卖者，要把对未来付款的索取权认定为“资本”，要把某些安排认定为商品、把另一些认定为经济行动者，每一项都取决于将某些财产界定为资产的规则、价格形成机制、对商品进行协商性描述和分类的方式、安排工作过程的方法，以及组装行动能力的技术。
每一次经济交换行为，都只有通过援引、确立和重新实施这些规则、机制和分类才能发生。像“市场”或“经济的”这样的抽象，指的不是某种独立的社会现实领域，而是一种处于持续建构和争夺之中的安排。
en: On the one hand, as Polanyi himself makes clear, ‘market society’ never successfully frees itself from those entanglements. The domestic household, political authority, physical compulsion, and social obligation are all reorganised to support, enforce, or compensate for the operation of new laws of property and contract. On the other, the idea of the disembedding of the economic assumes that the economic market exists as a kind of abstract space, already populated with its buyers, sellers, and commodities. As Michel Callon points out, the concept tends to overlook all the continuing work that must be done to ‘embed’ labour, capital, or merchandise in relations of market exchange. In fact, to constitute some agency as a buyer and another as a seller, to recognise a claim on future payments as ‘capital’, and to identify some arrangements as items of merchandise and others as economic agents, in each case depends upon rules for defining certain property as assets, mechanisms of price formation, negotiated descriptions and categorisations of goods, ways of arranging work processes, and techniques of assembling agency.

Every act of economic exchange occurs only by invoking, establishing, and re-enacting these rules, mechanisms, and categorisations. An abstraction such as ‘the market’ or ‘the economic’ designates not some freestanding sphere of social reality but an arrangement under continual construction and contestation.

zh: 换句话说，不是在十八世纪、而是在十九世纪末出现的“经济的”概念，不应被理解为集体生活中一个独立领域的创造——即在“经济”一词本身尚未如此使用之前就制造出“经济”——而应被理解为对一个过程的指称。形成和指定何为经济的过程——以独特方式使世界可计算——可以被称为“经济化”。在资本主义发展的图示性叙述中，这一转变被描述为“经济的”作为实在抽象的创造；更好的理解是，“经济化”是一项持续不断、从未完成的工作。
en: Another way to say this is that the concept of ‘the economic’ that emerged, not in the eighteenth century but towards the end of the nineteenth, should be grasped not as the creation of a distinct sphere of collective life, the making of ‘the economy’ before the word itself was used in this way, but the designation of a process. The process of forming and designating what is economic – of rendering the world calculable in distinctive ways – can be described as ‘economising’. The transformation characterised in schematic accounts of the development of capitalism as the creation of ‘the economic’ as a real abstraction is better understood as the continual, never-completed work of ‘economisation’.

zh: 虽然本书关注的是资产化或资本化过程，即把未来商品转化为当下可以控制、贴现和交易的资产，但资本化始终依赖于经济化的行为。
en: While our focus in this book is on the process of assetisation or capitalisation, by which future goods are converted into assets that can be controlled, discounted, and traded in the present, capitalisation always depends on acts of economisation.

zh: 我们将在本章后面回到经济化问题，以理解马克斯·韦伯著作中对经济化过程的分析——其部分动机来自资本化的挑战——如何无意中促成了把它转化为一个对象，即“这个经济整体”（the economy）。目前，经济化有两个特征值得注意。第一，
使事物变得可计算的过程的一个重要方面是经济学文本的写作。在十九世纪确立政治经济学作为科学领域时，这些著作与其说是在描述“经济的”，不如说是在力图把获取和保护财富确立为社会生活的一个独立领域，服从于自身的计算和法则。以英语世界最有影响的著作为例，约翰·斯图亚特·密尔的
。它的主题不是“经济的”（密尔没有把这个词用作名词），而是财富，更具体地说，“人类……从事获取和保存财富”的活动。
在他有影响的文章《论政治经济学的定义及其研究方法》中，密尔坚持认为，政治经济学是更广泛领域“社会经济学”（或“政治科学”）的一个分支，是其中仅把人作为“渴望占有财富的存在”来关心的部分。
这种存在方式，即人作为财富的渴望者，在经济科学的

中被表述和促成。（十九世纪政治经济学中的“经济的”一词不仅是形容词而非名词；它还从不描述物质世界的一个方面，而是——正如我们刚才在讨论克罗默勋爵治理埃及的记述时所指出的——描述道德世界的一个方面，即一组期望中的规则、原则、社会法则或心理习惯。）因此，政治经济学执行了抽象化、经济化的一部分工作。关于这一主题的著作持续运作，以分离其论题、区分它所适用的物质过程，并建构其行动者应当遵循的原则。据说实在抽象所对应的“真实世界”，是一个包含政治经济学工作的世界。
en: We will come back to economisation later in the chapter, to understand how the analysis of the process of economising in the work of Max Weber, motivated, in part, by the challenges of capitalisation, inadvertently contributed to its transposition into an object, ‘the economy’. For now, there are two features of economisation to note. First, a

significant aspect of the process of rendering things calculable was the writing of texts on economics. In establishing political economy in the nineteenth century as a scientific field, such works were not so much describing ‘the economic’ as attempting to secure the acquisition and protection of wealth as a distinct realm of social life, subject to its own calculations and laws. Take the most influential work in English, John Stuart Mill’s
. Its subject is not ‘the economic’ (a term Mill does not use as a noun) but wealth, and more specifically ‘mankind as occupied . . . in acquiring and conserving wealth’.

In his influential essay ‘On the Definition of Political Economy; and on the Method of Investigation Proper to It’, Mill insists that political economy is a branch of the wider field of ‘social economy’ (or the ‘science of politics’), being the part concerned with man ‘solely as a being who desires to possess wealth’.
This mode of being, man as desirer of wealth, is formulated and facilitated in the

of economic science. (The term ‘economic’ in nineteenth-century political economy is not only an adjective, rather than a noun; it is also one that never describes an aspect of the material world but rather, as we noted just now in discussing Lord Cromer’s account of governing Egypt, an aspect of the moral world – a set of desired rules, principles, social laws, or mental habits.) Thus, political economy performs part of the work of abstracting, of economisation. Writings on the subject operate continually to separate its topic, distinguish those material processes to which it applies, and construct the principles on which its agents should act. The ‘real world’ to which a real abstraction is said to correspond is a world that includes the work of political economy.
body.review: 校注：正文此处以《政治经济学原理》为例，但紧随引句的原注060所列出处为〈论政治经济学的定义〉第138页。书名与注中出处不一致，均保留原作。

zh: 第二，这种区分和具体化的过程——无论是通过政治经济学、法律、治理还是生产组织的工作——不断受到削弱。这是一项差异化的工作，只能通过重复、通过反复排除不属于“经济的”计算的东西来运作。但在这一过程中，被排除者不断施加压力，通过其被排除而塑造那个将它排除在外的范畴本身。
因此，“政治的”“家庭的”以及外部的或“殖民的”等范畴，都作为被内化的外部而运作。分离的不完整性不只是历史过程的症状，也不是随时间推移、随着过程趋于完成而得到弥补的东西。它是“经济的”这类抽象效果得以产生的方式中一个必要且永无止境的特征。
en: Second, this process of differentiation and specification, whether through the work of political economy, law, government, or productive organisation, is continually undermined. It is a work of difference that can operate only by repetition, by repeatedly excluding what does not belong to the calculation of ‘the economic’. But, in the process, what is excluded continually exerts pressure upon, shaping by its exclusion, the very category from which it is excluded.

Thus categories such as ‘the political’, ‘the domestic’, and the external or ‘colonial’ all operate as the internalised outside. The incompleteness of the separation is not just a symptom of a historical process, remedied over time as the process tends towards completion. It is a necessary and never-ending feature of the way an abstract effect like ‘the economic’ is produced.

zh: 信用的代言人
en: Spokesmen of Credit

zh: 一位十九世纪思想家理解了政治经济学的经济化工作，然后认识到这种工作如何从内部受到削弱、如何改变，并创造出新的对象。卡尔·马克思在 1844 年开始研究他所谓的亚当·斯密、让—巴蒂斯特·萨伊和大卫·李嘉图的“经典著作”，当时他才二十五岁上下。三年后，他指出这些著作与真理有一种特殊关系。它们所发展的法则，只有在如下假设下才是真实的：
en: One nineteenth-century thinker understood the economising work of political economy, and then learned how it was undermined from within, was altered, and created new objects. Karl Marx began his study of what he called ‘the classical works’ of Adam Smith, Jean-Baptiste Say, and David Ricardo in 1844, when still in his mid-twenties. Three years later, he remarked that these writings had a particular relationship to the truth. The laws they developed were true only under the supposition that

zh: 竞争完全自由，不仅在一个国家之内，而且在全世界范围内。A. 斯密、萨伊和李嘉图所发展的这些法则，即财富据以生产和分配的法则——这些法则随着自由贸易的实现而变得更加真实、更加精确，然后不再只是抽象。
en: competition be perfectly free, not only within a single country, but upon the whole face of the earth. These laws, which A. Smith, Say, and Ricardo, have developed, the laws under which wealth is produced and distributed – these laws grow more true, more exact, then cease to be mere abstractions, in the same measure in which Free Trade is carried out.

zh: 因此，他总结说，经济学家“对未来社会的了解，比对当下社会的了解更多。如果你想读一读未来之书，就翻开斯密、萨伊、李嘉图的著作。”
政治经济学是一门随时间推移会变得更加准确的科学，因为社会关系和物质关系会逐渐按照其原则组织起来——或者说经济化。
en: As a consequence, he concluded, the economists ‘know more about society as it will be, than about society as it is. If you wish to read in the book of the future, open Smith, Say, Ricardo.’
Political economy was a science that would become more accurate with time, as social and material relations were gradually organised – or economised – according to its principles.

zh: 然而，未来的发展并非如此。马克思后来发现，经济化的过程——经济法则借以“变得更加真实”的过程——总是不完整的。这个过程周期性地被逼上另一条道路。他曾着手写作一部政治经济学“批判”，这个项目持续写作和重写了随后二十年。1867 年，他终于出版了成果，即
第一卷；正如我们指出的，该卷主要论述十九世纪中叶的英国工厂制度。但那时，正如沃尔特·白芝浩不久后所指出的，政治经济学已经在失去对公众头脑的掌控。马克思本人显然已经放弃了撰写这部政治经济学批判的计划。他最初计划再写几卷
，但从未完成。另外两卷由弗里德里希·恩格斯在马克思去世后根据其早期笔记和片段整理而成。
这种放弃似乎反映了这样一个事实：政治经济学著作所设想的建立在自由竞争基础上的“商业社会”或“资产阶级社会”并未出现。然而，那种未来愿景并非败于马克思试图展开的
揭露其内部矛盾的“批判”，也并非败于那些矛盾螺旋式扩张所预示的革命性自我毁灭。它正让位于新的财产所有权定义、新的集体实验和新的攫取未来的方式。
en: Yet the future did not unfold that way. The process of economising, by which the laws of economics ‘grow more true’, Marx was to discover, was always incomplete. Periodically, the process was forced onto a different path. He had set to work on a ‘critique’ of political economy, a project whose writing and rewriting consumed the following two decades. In 1867, he finally published the result, volume one of

, which, as we noted, dealt mainly with the English factory system of the mid-nineteenth century. But, by then, as Walter Bagehot was soon to point out, political economy was already losing its hold on the public mind. Marx himself had evidently given up on the project of its critique. He had originally planned several further volumes of
but never completed them. Two further volumes were pieced together posthumously by Friedrich Engels from Marx’s earlier notebooks and fragments.

The abandonment seems to reflect the fact that the ‘commercial society’ or ‘bourgeois society’ built on free competition that the works of political economy envisioned had not come about. That vision of the future had succumbed, however, not to the ‘critique’

exposing its internal contradictions that Marx had attempted to develop, nor to the revolutionary self-destruction predicted to follow from the spiralling expansion of those contradictions. It was giving way to new definitions of property ownership, new collective experiments, and new modes of capturing the future.

zh: 政治经济学曾预见的未来，其部分替代方案正在别处得到巩固，例如废除农奴制后俄罗斯村社中重新出现的共同所有制形式，马克思对此产生了兴趣。
然而，另一些替代方案则从英国工厂制度本身发展出来。一个例子是企业合作所有制，马克思称赞它“不仅是一个伟大的实践成功”，而且是“劳动的政治经济学对财产的政治经济学的一场胜利”。
一个更重大的发展是现代股份公司，以及促成它的信用创造能力的扩展。马克思著名地把生产私人所有权向股东所有权的过渡，视为“资本主义生产方式内部的资本主义生产方式的废除”——尤其是因为资本如今可以像他所说的那样“虚构地”创造出来，作为对未来生产的索取权。
他从古典政治经济学家那里借用了虚拟资本的概念，后者曾用这个短语描述融通汇票（上一章已提到），即在没有底层商品销售的情况下作为信用货币创造的汇票。
然而，到马克思出版
第一卷时，所谓“虚拟”信用已不只是商人银行家用来创造汇票的工具。在推动修建铁路、港口和城市地产的股份公司大量涌现的过程中，大部分资本是通过“虚构”创造并出售对一项将由未来支付的收入的股份而产生的。这种虚构如今相当真实。
en: Some of these alternatives to the future that political economy had once anticipated were being consolidated elsewhere, such as forms of communal ownership re-emerging in the village communities of Russia following the abolition of serfdom, in which Marx developed an interest.

Others, however, grew out of the English factory system itself. One example was the cooperative owning of enterprises, which Marx celebrated as ‘not only a great practical success’, but a ‘victory of the political economy of labour over the political economy of property’.

A more significant development was the modern joint-stock company, together with the expanded powers of credit creation that enabled it.
