Marx famously saw the transition from the private ownership of production to its ownership by shareholders as ‘the abolition of the capitalist mode of production within the capitalist mode of production itself’ – not least because capital could now be created ‘fictitiously’, as he put it, as a claim on future production.

He borrowed the notion of fictitious capital from the classical political economists, who had used the phrase to describe bills of accommodation (mentioned in the previous chapter), meaning bills of exchange created as credit money where there was no underlying sale of goods.
By the time Marx published volume one of

, however, so-called ‘fictitious’ credit was not just a device used by merchant bankers to create bills. In the proliferation of joint-stock companies promoting the construction of railways, ports, and urban property, most capital was coming into being through the ‘fiction’ of creating and selling shares in a revenue to be paid from the future. The fiction was now quite real.
body.review: 校注：正文把两段赞语连用于合作所有制，但原注067所引全文中，“不仅是一个伟大的实践成就”指十小时法案；后面的劳动政治经济学对财产政治经济学的胜利才转指合作运动。正文保留原作引述方式，请与原注合读。

zh: 马克思意识到，塑造和预测社会未来进程的已不再是古典政治经济学家，而是扩大信用创造的先驱。他举了两个例子。一个是约翰·劳，这位声名狼藉的十八世纪苏格兰裔法国金融家，他曾任法国财政总监，接管了一个失败的殖民项目——密西西比公司，并授予其法国在北美和西印度群岛全部贸易的垄断权。该计划与建立一家有权发行纸币信用的私人国家银行相结合，制造了一个投机泡沫，于 1720 年破灭。另一个例子是马克思的同时代人伊萨克·佩雷尔，一位法国
铁路企业家，他与兄弟埃米尔共同创办了金融公司动产信贷银行。该公司开创了一种新颖的股份融资模式，用“投资银行”的新业务取代私人、绅士式的商人银行，向公众出售金融项目以及银行本身的股份。
该项目通过推销铁路股票、政府战争贷款、房地产开发和其他债务，创造了数亿法郎的信用货币，包括向奥斯曼政府提供贷款，以及在马赛开发港口和铁路连接；人们曾预计，苏伊士运河建成后，马赛将成为可与利物浦匹敌的国际航运枢纽。
1867 年 9 月，也就是
第一卷终于问世的那个月，这家银行及其房地产帝国在债务中崩溃。原因包括马赛未能成为新的利物浦，以及当年巴黎世界博览会未能吸引预期的数百万游客，削弱了巴黎的房地产投机——这是六年后维也纳世界博览会失败、进而引发 1870 年代全球金融危机的先兆。
马克思后来评论说，约翰·劳、伊萨克·佩雷尔和其他这类“信用的代言人”，具有“骗子和先知令人愉快的混合性格”。
en: Marx realised that it was no longer the classical political economists whose work shaped and predicted the future course of society. It was the pioneers of expanded credit creation. He offered two examples. One was John Law, the infamous eighteenth-century Scottish French financier who as Controller General of Finances in France took over a failing colonisation project, the Mississippi Company, and granted it a monopoly of all French trade in North America and the West Indies. Combined with establishing a private national bank with the power to issue paper credit, the scheme created a speculative bubble that burst in 1720. The other example was a contemporary of Marx, Isaac Pereire, a French

railway entrepreneur who with his brother Émile founded the finance company Crédit Mobilier. Pioneering a novel model of joint-stock finance, the Company replaced private, gentlemanly merchant banking with the new business of ‘investment banking’, selling shares in financial ventures, and in the bank itself, to the public.

The venture created hundreds of millions of francs in credit money by marketing railway shares, government war loans, property development, and other debt, including the supply of loans to the Ottoman government and the development of port and rail connections at Marseilles, a city that was expected to rival Liverpool as a node of international shipping following the building of the Suez Canal.
In September 1867, the same month in which volume one of

had finally appeared, the bank and its property empire collapsed in debt. The causes included the failure of Marseilles to become a new Liverpool and the weakening of Paris property speculations when the Exposition Universelle that year failed to attract the millions of expected visitors – a precursor to the failure of the Vienna world exhibition six years later that was to trigger the global financial crisis of the 1870s.
John Law, Isaac Pereire, and other such ‘spokesmen of credit’, Marx later observed, were endowed ‘with the pleasant character mixture of swindler and prophet’.

zh: 马克思退回到这样一种观念：这些骗子创造的资本是“虚拟的”，理由是他们以公司股份和其他资产形式出售的未来剩余尚未被创造出来。这种观点源于他较早的理解，即资本是从过去积累起来、然后通过物质生产劳动转化为更大数额的资金。但正如我们所见，资本本身是作为对未来的有效索取权而产生的。工业劳动及其工资——工资以未来消费为依据、作为信用预支——只是日益增多的从未来索取的方法中的一个方面。未来并非只由骗子和先知召唤的虚构，而是一套精心建造的攫取装置，其组织方式使控制它的人能够在当下以折扣价实现未来收入，然后把偿还作为负担强加给未来。
en: Marx fell back on the idea that capital created by such swindlers was ‘fictitious’, on the grounds that the future surplus they were selling in the form of company shares and other assets had not yet been created. This view followed from his earlier understanding of capital as a fund accumulated from the past and then transformed through the labour of material production into a larger amount. But, as we have seen, capital itself comes into being as an effective claim on the future. Industrial labour and its wage, advanced as credit against future consumption, is only one aspect of the proliferating methods of claiming from the future. The future is not a fiction conjured up only by swindlers and prophets, but an elaborate apparatus of capture organised to allow those who control it to realise future revenues at a discount in the present and then impose repayment as a burden on the future.

zh: 由此可知，经济化工作从来不像在经济与政治之间建构一道分界那样简单。它需要新财产形式的大量涌现，尤其是那些作为未来索取权存在的财产形式，例如公司股份。而且它容易受到一切未来关系不稳定性的影响。
en: The work of economising, it follows, is never as simple as constructing a divide between the economic and the political. It requires the proliferation of new forms of property, in particular those forms of property that exist as claims on the future, such as the company share. And it is open to the instability of all relations to the future.

zh: 商业问题
en: The Business Problem

zh: 股市帮助创造了独特化商品的现象——这种商品召唤出买者、卖者和可知的价格——新兴的、更狭窄的经济学学科可以围绕它组织起来。然而，这种价格机制的科学难以确立自身。在十九世纪后期的早年，其实践者仍然觉得需要谈论价格体系之外的某些东西；几十年过去后，大多数经济学家才同意把其知识领域缩小到价格机制的研究。这种缩小伴随着其他概念的出现，用以指称经济学家当时已在很大程度上排除在其研究之外的价格体系以外的物质过程。正如我们在前面几章所指出的，其中最重要的概念将是“技术”一词，它最终成为一个包罗万象的术语——实际上也是一种托词——用来描述那些反复扰乱价格形成之稳定钟摆的所谓非经济力量。
但在十九世纪末，许多经济学家仍然觉得需要在解释中纳入价格机制之外技术政治世界的某些东西。
en: The stock market helped create the phenomenon of the singularised commodity that summons into being a buyer, a seller, and a knowable price, in association with which the new and narrower discipline of economics could be organised. Yet the science of this price mechanism struggled to establish itself. In these early years, during the late nineteenth century, its practitioners still felt the need to speak about something more than the system of prices; several decades passed before most economists agreed to narrow their field of knowledge to the study of the price mechanism. That narrowing would be accompanied by the emergence of other concepts, to reference the material processes outside the price system that economists by then had largely excluded from their study. The most significant of these, as we have suggested in earlier chapters, was to be the word ‘technology’, which eventually operated as a catchall term – and indeed an alibi – to describe so-called noneconomic forces that repeatedly disturbed the stabilising pendulum of price formation.
But, in the late nineteenth century, many economists still felt the need to incorporate into their explanations something of the technopolitical world beyond the price mechanism.

zh: 剑桥大学经济学家阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的著作可以说明这些困难。在剑桥，马歇尔把政治经济学研究从道德科学领域的原有位置移出，建立了一个独立的经济学系。
他的

第一版于 1890 年问世，最初打算作为两卷本教科书的一半，它在四十多年里帮助界定了这门新学科的范围和方法。马歇尔推广了一种把商品或货物表示为机制的图表，形式是一张曲线图，横轴表示商品数量递增，纵轴表示价格上升。一条向右上方上升的曲线描绘“供给”，假定它随价格上升而增长；一条向右下方下降的曲线描绘“需求”，假定它随价格上升而减少。这创造了一种竞争体系的抽象再现，其中供给和需求形成相互抵消的“力量”，其交点是一个平衡点或“均衡”点。教科书第二卷原本打算用价格体系之外其他过程的“现实”记述，来补充这种把市场描绘为自动机制的抽象图景。马歇尔最终放弃了这一尝试。“我把计划定得太大了，”他指出，“随着当前这一代工业革命的每一次脉动，它的范围都扩大了，
尤其是在现实方面；这场工业革命在速度和运动广度上都远远超过了一个世纪前的变革。”他提出，“完成这项任务需要四卷厚书”。
en: The work of Alfred Marshall, the leading Cambridge economist, can illustrate these difficulties. At Cambridge, Marshall removed the study of political economy from its existing home as part of the field of moral sciences and established a separate faculty of economics.
His

, whose first edition appeared in 1890 and was initially intended as one-half of a two-volume textbook, helped define the scope and method of the new discipline for more than four decades. Marshall popularised a diagram representing a commodity or good as a mechanism, in the form of a graph with the quantity of the good increasing along the x-axis and its price rising up the y-axis. A curve ascending towards the right depicted ‘supply’, assumed to grow as the price rose, while one descending towards the right pictured the ‘demand’ for it, assumed to decline as its price increased. This created an abstract representation of a competitive system in which supply and demand formed counteracting ‘forces’ whose intersection was a point of balance or ‘equilibrium’. The second volume of the textbook was intended to complement this abstract portrayal of the market as an automatic mechanism with a ‘realistic’ account of other processes, beyond those of the price system. Marshall eventually abandoned the attempt. ‘I had laid my plan on too large a scale’, he noted, ‘and its scope widened, especially

on the realistic side, with every pulse of that Industrial Revolution of the present generation, which has far outdone the changes of a century ago, in both rapidity and breadth of movement.’ He suggested that ‘four thick volumes would be needed for the task’.

zh: 马歇尔曾希望借助一个新颖观念——
过程——来理解正在发生的更广泛运动。他抛开价格机制的物理学，转向生物学的隐喻。他提出，组织概念表达了一种复杂性不断增加的历史过程，其特征是相互依赖和各种力量的相互作用。关注点集中在“工业斗争”——J. A. 霍布森的
曾提到这一点——以及马歇尔等人开始称之为“工业
”的东西。体系和组织的概念指的是一个相互锁合的世界：铁路网络、钢铁制造、煤炭和石油生产、发电、工业化学和大规模机器过程，连同发展起来控制这些过程的大型新股份公司和金融企业；霍布森将这一切称为“一个单一的有机整体”。
en: Marshall had hoped to make sense of the wider movements at work by means of a novel idea, the process of

. Leaving aside the physics of the price mechanism, he turned to metaphors from biology. He proposed that the concept of organisation expressed a historical process of increasing complexity, characterised by interdependence and the interaction of forces. The concern focused on the ‘industrial struggle’, to which J. A. Hobson’s
referred, and on what Marshall and others began to call the ‘industrial

’. The concepts of system and organisation referred to the interlocking world of railway networks, iron- and steelmaking, coal and oil production, electrical power generation, industrial chemistry, and large-scale machine processes, together with the sizeable new joint-stock companies and financial firms that grew to control these processes and made them what Hobson termed ‘a single organic whole’.

zh: 股市、商品交易所、货币交易商和其他金融机制制造了一个可以记录和绘制的价格世界，但它们是这场大得多的重组中可见的、简化的部分。使这种价格生产成为可能的更广泛安排，正如我们所见，包括为了供应大宗商品而对地区进行的生态改造，从被改造成整齐划一麦田的美国中西部草原，到被排干以建立棉花和甘蔗种植园的尼罗河围堤蓄水田区；运送军队、病原体、金融票据和作物的铁路计划——铁路公司在可交易股票的公司中占据多数；安排和担保信用供给的银行和保险公司；以及许多其他相互锁合的过程。“体系”和“组织”等术语试图把这些相互依赖和不稳定的形式，与较早政治经济学家所研究的那种离散的“工业”形式区分开来。但正如马歇尔未能完成其后续卷册所证明的，价格抽象科学无法与对这个生态、帝国和工业过程广阔空间及其展开斗争的理解相协调。
en: While stock markets, commodity exchanges, currency dealers, and other financial mechanisms manufactured a world of prices that could be recorded and charted, they were the visible, simplified part of this much larger reorganisation. The wider arrangements that made possible the production of such prices included, as we have seen, the ecological remaking of regions to supply bulk commodities, from the prairies of the American Midwest homogenised into wheat fields, to the flood basins of the Nile dried out to create cotton and sugar plantations; the railway schemes that moved armies, pathogens, financial paper, and crops and accounted for the majority of firms whose shares could be traded; the banks and insurance companies that arranged and guaranteed the supply of credit; and many other interlocking processes. Terms like ‘system’ and ‘organisation’ attempted to distinguish these forms of interdependence and instability from the discrete forms of ‘industry’ that earlier political economists had studied. But as Marshall’s failed attempt to produce the subsequent volumes of his textbook testified, the abstract science of prices proved impossible to reconcile with understanding this wide space of ecological, imperial, and industrial processes and the struggles unfolding there.

zh: 摆脱这一僵局、并为经济诞生准备基础的办法，同样可以理解为一种经济化过程。研究对象本身产生了
科学反过来帮助抽象、形式化和计算的推理、理性和可计算性模式。我们可以通过考察另一个观念的发展来审视这是如何发生的；这个观念在“经济”被发明之前的几十年里开始在英语中通用——我们在上一章结尾注意到其出现的对象，即“商业”领域。经济学家提到一个由“商人”或“金融城人士”（city men）组成的世界。他们甚至承认，自己的著作主要适用于这些人的计算，并将改进他们的核算。
在美国经济学家中，对这些过程更宽泛的说法是“商业企业”，例如托斯丹·凡勃伦 1905 年的批判性著作
这个说法越来越多地被简称为“商业”。这个有机体系波动的命运成为一个重要的调查主题。尤其是它反复出现的扩张和衰退，如今被作为“商业周期”问题来研究。1913 年，凡勃伦最著名的学生韦斯利·克莱尔·米切尔出版了一部 600 页的研究
，主张萧条和金融危机不是由战争、作物歉收或技术发明等“异常现象”引起的，而是由“商业企业之间的相互依赖”本身引起的，由于这种相互依赖，它们如今“构成一个体系”。
正如我们将看到的，思考随后经济诞生的一种方式，是认为后一个术语把“商业”作为有机体系的观念翻译成一个扩大了的、带有更受规整的时间性的概念。
en: The solution that emerged to this impasse, and that was to prepare the ground for the birth of the economy, can be grasped, again, as a process of economisation. The object of study itself produced the

modes of reason, rationality, and calculability that the science in turn helped to abstract, formalise, and calculate upon. We can examine how this happened by considering the development of another idea that came into common use in English, in the decades prior to the invention of ‘the economy’ – the object whose emergence we noted at the end of the previous chapter, the realm of ‘business’. Economists referred to a world populated by ‘men of business’, or ‘city men’. They even acknowledged that it was to the calculations of these men that they thought their work mainly applied, and whose reckonings it would improve.
Among American economists a wider term for these processes was ‘business enterprise’, as portrayed in books such as Thorstein Veblen’s critical 1905 work,

Increasingly the phrase was shortened to just ‘business’. The fluctuating fortunes of this organic system became an important subject of investigation. In particular, its repeated episodes of expansion and decline were now studied as the problem of ‘business cycles’. In 1913, Veblen’s most famous student, Wesley Clair Mitchell, published a 600-page study,

, arguing that episodes of depression and financial crisis were caused not by ‘abnormal phenomena’ such as war, crop failure, or technical inventions, but by the very ‘interdependence of business enterprises’, as a consequence of which they now ‘constitute a system’.

One way to think of the subsequent birth of the economy, as we will see, is that the latter term provided a translation of the idea of ‘business’ as an organic system into an expanded concept, equipped with a more regulated temporality.

zh: 铁路公司，尤其是美国的铁路公司，是这种不断扩张的攫取装置的主要例子——即使在当时，它看起来也是一种向未来征税的方式。
en: The railroad companies, especially those of the United States, were the main example of this expanding apparatus of capture – a mode of taxing the future, as it appeared even at the time.

zh: 十九世纪末出现了一波突然的合并和收购浪潮——1894 年后十年间的“大合并运动”，食品制造、石油、煤炭、金属和运输行业的公司合并或被接管，形成许多二十世纪最大的公司。到二十世纪中叶，这些公司的股市价值指数——尤其是标普 500 指数，代表从每个产业部门中选出的最大公司——与国内生产总值（GDP）一起，成为衡量经济健康以及政府成败的主要指标之一。
en: A sudden wave of mergers and acquisitions took place at the end of the nineteenth century – the ‘great merger movement’ of the decade after 1894, in which companies in food manufacturing, petroleum, coal, metals, and transport merged or were taken over to form many of the largest corporations of the twentieth century. By the mid-twentieth century, indices of the stock market value of these companies – notably the S&P 500, representing the largest firms selected to represent every sector of industry – became, alongside the gross domestic product, or GDP, one of the principal measures of the health of the economy and the success and failure of government.

zh: 在这里，人们可以简洁地看到经济化过程在起作用。商业研究中有一个关于
大型企业兴起的标准故事。这一故事在阿尔弗雷德·D. 钱德勒 1977 年的经典著作

中得到阐述。钱德勒反驳凡勃伦的观点——凡勃伦把商业企业解释为一种基于扰乱工业体系能力的剩余攫取方式——主张大型一体化企业是对协调问题的自然回应。随着民族国家规模扩大、人口增长、交通基础设施扩展，市场关系不再是协调供应者、制造商、分销商和消费者之间交换的最有效方式。职能协调和材料分配由专业管理者处理更为有效。这些管理者位于大公司的各个部门内部。管理型企业的成长，是对现代工业生活日益增长的技术复杂性的回应。
en: Here, one can see succinctly the processes of economisation at work. There is a standard story in business studies about the rise of the
large business firm. It was laid out in Alfred D. Chandler’s classic work of 1977,

. Countering the views of Veblen, who had explained business enterprise as a mode of capturing surplus based on the ability to disrupt the industrial system, Chandler argued that the large, integrated firm was a natural response to the problem of coordination. As nation-states expanded in size, as their populations grew, and as transportation infrastructures spread, market relations were no longer the most efficient way to coordinate exchanges among suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and consumers. The coordination of functions and allocation of materials was more efficiently handled by professional managers. These were located within the different divisions of the large corporation. The growth of the managerial firm was a response to the growing technical complexity of modern industrial life.

zh: 钱德勒的叙述主要基于铁路公司的历史。这并不奇怪。1880 年代，在纽约证券交易所交易的百余家公司中，约九十家是铁路公司，其余大多是相关企业——电报公司、快递公司和类似企业。钱德勒认为，铁路运营带来的巨大挑战和机遇——制定时刻表、计算运费、协调机车和车厢的移动等等——促成并推动了新管理技能的发展，大型公司正是由这些技能塑造而成。
en: Chandler’s account was based largely on the history of railroad firms. This is no surprise. In the 1880s, some ninety of the hundred-plus firms traded on the New York stock exchange were railway companies, and most of the rest were related businesses – telegraph companies, express mail firms, and similar enterprises. Chandler argued that the great challenges and opportunities presented by the running of railways – setting timetables, calculating freight prices, coordinating the movement of locomotives and rail cars, and so on – enabled and spurred the development of the new managerial skills out of which the large corporation was formed.

zh: 让我们以另一种方式考虑这个故事，不是由技术复杂性日益增加这一简单逻辑——由“技术”的力量——驱动，而是以它例示经济化运作的方式。铁路的建设和运营需要新型工程知识和计算知识。

早在 1832 年就已创刊，通过汇集关于桥梁、转车台、机车和其他机械及技术结构工程的技术知识，来教育年轻工程师。但铁路不仅、或许甚至主要不是一种提高运输和通信速度与规模的技术系统。正如我们所知，它们还是吸引股东投资、从土地价格投机以及铁路建设所产生的其他机会中获利的手段。因此，铁路不仅要求并鼓励工程知识的发展，也要求并鼓励新形式金融信息和计算的发展。它们自己公布的运费、票价、轨道里程、股价和其他运营数据，正是这个金融世界的
构建材料。它们是经济化过程的重要部分。
en: Let us consider this story differently, in a way that is not driven by a simple logic of increasing technical complexity – by the force of ‘technology’ – but in the way it exemplifies economisation at work. The building and running of railways required new kinds of engineering and calculative knowledge. The

was a publication that had been launched as early as 1832 to educate young engineers by gathering know-how about the engineering of bridges, turntables, locomotives, and other machinery and technical structures. But railways were not only, or perhaps even primarily, a technical system for improving the speed and scale of transport and communication. As we know, they were also a means of attracting shareholder investment and profiting from speculation in land prices and other opportunities to which railway construction gave rise. So, the railways required and encouraged the growth not only of engineering know-how, but of new forms of financial information and calculation. Their own published freight rates, ticket prices, track mileage, share prices, and other operational data were the building blocks
of this financial world. They were a vital part of the process of economisation.

zh: 工业装置与经济及金融信息格式化之间的这种关系，可以从
的演变中看出来。1849 年，新英格兰铁路大亨约翰·普尔买下该杂志，并让其兄弟亨利·瓦纳姆·普尔担任编辑。随着铁路组建公司并发行债券和股票，亨利·普尔开始在刊载工程知识之外发布金融信息。该杂志发展出再现和传播铁路正在产生并赖以生存的金融数据的方式。从 1868 年起，瓦纳姆·普尔每年以
这一新形式系统列表整理这些信息，详细列出每条铁路的债券、股票、里程、收益和开支，以及每家公司的历史。最终，
每年发布 128 家铁路公司的数据。
en: This relation between an industrial apparatus and the formatting of economic and financial information can be seen in what happened to the

. In 1849, a New England railway magnate, John Poor, purchased the journal and gave its editorship to his brother, Henry Varnum Poor. Alongside engineering knowledge, Henry Poor began to publish financial information, as railways were incorporated and issued bonds and stocks. The journal developed ways of representing and circulating the financial data that railroads were generating and depending upon. From 1868, Varnum Poor tabulated this information systematically each year in a new form called the

children: Manual of the Railroads of the United States

en: , detailing for each railroad their bonds, stocks, mileage, earnings, and expenses, along with a history of each corporation. Eventually the
was publishing annual data on 128 railroad companies.

zh: 这种经济化工作是由资本化的困难驱动的。
第一卷的导言提请注意“铁路名义

不断增加、而其获利能力没有任何增加”这一“大恶”。瓦纳姆·普尔举例说，一条造价 4,868,428 美元的铁路，通过连续发行股票和债券，创造了 11,250,000 美元的资本账户。铁路没有降低运价，而是“把沿线商业和旅行课税到最大限度”，以支付这些资本的利息和股息。“一项本应按 4,868,428 美元成本收费的运输，如今却要按这一数额的两倍半收费。”普尔写道，这是众多此类侵害之一，“不仅侵害了铁路经济的真正原则，也侵害了公众权利”。
意在制衡这些“侵害”，希望监督和规范把此类未来索取权推向市场的过程，以及它们借此把未来商业和旅行“课税到最大限度”的做法。资本化未来的实践本身，开始反过来产生统计知识形式，“经济的”或许可以通过这些形式被认识和规范。
en: This economising work was driven by the difficulties of capitalisation. The introduction to the first volume of the
drew attention to the ‘great evil’ of the ‘constant increase in the nominal

of railroads, without any addition to their capacity to earn’. Varnum Poor gave the example of a railroad built at a cost of $4,868,428, which had made successive issues of stocks and bonds to create a capital account of $11,250,000. Instead of reducing rates, ‘the commerce and travel of the route is taxed to the utmost extent’, to pay the interest and dividends on this capital. ‘A traffic which should have paid on a cost of $4,868,428, is made to pay on two and a half times this sum.’ This was one of many such violations, Poor wrote, ‘not only of the true principles of railway economy but of popular right’.
The

was intended as a check on these ‘violations’, hoping to monitor and regulate the very process of marketing such claims to the future and their practice of thereby taxing future commerce and travel ‘to the utmost extent’. The very practice of capitalising the future began to generate in reaction the forms of statistical knowledge through which ‘the economic’ might be known and regulated.
body.review: 校注：按本段所列数额计算，11,250,000÷4,868,428约为2.31，与引文的“两倍半”不符。数额与引文均按底本保留。

zh: 1916 年，普尔的出版公司开始编制并出售它收集信息的那些公司所发行债务的信用评级。
另一家公司标准统计公司早十年前成立，为非铁路公司编制同样的信息（以易于更新的 5×7 英寸索引卡形式出版），并于 1922 年开始出售自己的评级。1941 年，两家公司合并组成标准普尔，这家信用评级和金融
信息机构建立了世界上第一个按市值加权的股市指数，也创设了今天所称的标普 500 指数。
en: In 1916, Poor’s publishing firm began to compile and sell ratings of the creditworthiness of the debt issued by the firms on which it collected information.

Another company, the Standard Statistics Bureau, founded a decade earlier to compile the same information for non-railroad companies (published in the form of 5 x 7–inch index cards that could be easily updated), began to sell its own ratings in 1922. In 1941, the two firms merged to form Standard and Poor’s, the credit rating and financial
information agency that established the world’s first value-weighted Stock Market Index, and what is today known as the S&P 500.

zh: 这说明经济化如何运作：它不是绘制一张预先存在的地形图，而是铺设轨道和连接，这些轨道和连接同时是运送货物和人员、创造对未来的商业和旅行“征税”的资本、以及构成和流通使这种对未来征税得以进行的数量、价格、指数和期货的手段。经济正是从这些相同的相互关联过程中产生，成为知识与规制的对象。
en: This illustrates how economisation works: not as the mapping of a pre-existing terrain, but as the laying out of tracks and connections that are simultaneously a means of moving goods and people, of creating the capital that ‘taxes’ future commerce and travel, and of constituting and circulating quantities, prices, indices, and futures that enables this taxation of the future to proceed. It was out of these same interconnected processes that the economy would emerge, as an object of knowledge and regulation.

zh: 经济化也通过学术知识的生产来运作。事实上，通过同样的连接和流通，产生了“商业”现象的
，这种历史可以用来为这种攫取未来的方式辩护，并成为其进一步的托词。亨利·瓦纳姆·普尔的私人文件由他的女儿露西·普尔保存。后来，这些文件在她位于马萨诸塞州剑桥附近布鲁克莱恩的房子的储藏室里，被她的一位侄孙发现，后者在她去世后搬进了这所房子。这位侄孙是瓦纳姆·普尔的曾孙，他利用这些文件在哈佛大学撰写了博士论文，内容包括对瓦纳姆·普尔的研究、美国铁路史，以及公司金融和管理的发展。
这篇博士论文的作者是阿尔弗雷德·杜邦·钱德勒。作为哈佛研究生，他受到塔尔科特·帕森斯以及帕森斯对韦伯组织理论解释的影响——我们很快将讨论这一点——并间接受到已故约瑟夫·熊彼特的影响。
他后来写了
，这本书确立了他作为美国商业史学界领袖的地位。钱德勒仔细研读其曾祖父汇编的统计和组织数据，为他那一代人做了“普尔曾做过的事”，从铁路的账簿和组织图中推导出对美国资本主义的理解——实际上是一种关于其独特形式即大型投资者所有公司的理论。
en: Economisation also works through the production of academic knowledge. In fact, through the same connections and circulations, a

of the phenomenon of ‘business’ was generated, one that could serve to justify and become a further alibi for this mode of capture of the future. Henry Varnum Poor’s personal papers were kept by his daughter, Lucy Poor. They were later discovered in a storeroom of her house in Brookline, near Cambridge, Massachusetts, by her great nephew, who moved into the house after her death. The nephew, a great grandson of Varnum Poor, used the papers to write his PhD thesis at Harvard, comprised of a study of Varnum Poor, the history of the American railways, and the development of corporate finance and management.

The author of the PhD was Alfred DuPont Chandler. As a graduate student at Harvard, he worked under the influence of Talcott Parsons and the Parsonian interpretation of Weberian organisation theory, to which we will shortly turn, and indirectly under the influence of the late Joseph Schumpeter.
He went on to write

, the book that established him as the dean of American business historians. Poring over the statistical and organisational data that his greatgrandfather had compiled, Chandler did for his own generation ‘just what Poor had done’, deriving from the account books and organisational charts of the railways an understanding of American capitalism – indeed a theory of its distinctive form, the large investor-owned corporation.

zh: 钱德勒的论文帮助推翻了托斯丹·凡勃伦关于大企业兴起的叙述，后者认为商人追求金钱利益会导致低效率和蓄意破坏。
则主张，在 1880 年代至 1920 年代期间，在美国铁路开创先河之后，公司
——组织图——取代了市场机制，并作为一种更有效地管理大型技术过程的方式做到了这一点。
经济化借以进行的图表、
账簿、商业记录和预测世界，帮助产生了商业世界日益依赖的辩护，即经济义论。
en: Chandler’s thesis helped overturn Thorstein Veblen’s account of the rise of big business, in which the pecuniary advantage pursued by businessmen led to inefficiency and sabotage.
argued instead that in the period from the 1880s to the 1920s, after pioneering by American railroads, corporate
– the organisational chart – took the place of market mechanisms, and did so as a more efficient way to manage large, technical processes.
The world of charts,
account books, business records, and projections through which economisation proceeds helped generate the justification – the oikodicy – on which the world of business increasingly depended.

zh: 经济将（不再）意味着经济化（economising）
en: Economy Shall (No Longer) Mean Economising

zh: 关于“经济”（economy）在“这个经济整体”（the economy）诞生之前的历史，让我们转向最后一个问题。是什么脱位或中断，导致了从把经济理解为过程到把经济理解为对象的转变？这种转变如何与“商业”的兴起、以及理解大型公司企业世界似乎所属的信用危机和“商业周期”的紧迫努力联系在一起？答案是，到两次世界大战之间，这些危机开始威胁未来本身，而资本化过程正有赖于这种未来的生产。资本主义——这个体系如今将被如此命名——被资本化危机削弱，似乎即将崩溃。回应就是发明“
经济整体”（the economy）。
en: Let us turn to a final question about the history of ‘economy’ before the birth of ‘the economy’. What dislocations or disruptions led to the change from understanding economy as process to economy as object? In what way was the shift connected to the rise of ‘business’, and to urgent attempts to understand the credit crises and ‘business cycles’ to which the world of large corporate firms seemed to belong? The answer is that by the interwar period these crises were beginning to threaten the very future on whose production the capitalising process depended. Weakened by the crises of capitalisation, capitalism itself, as the system would now be named, appeared about to collapse. The response was the invention of
economy.

zh: 这种转变似乎先出现在德国作家的著作中，然后才出现在英语中。这或许反映了德国学者对将其研究领域界定为“社会经济学”（
）的关切。约翰·斯图亚特·密尔曾呼应让—巴蒂斯特·萨伊，把政治经济学置于这一更广泛领域的一个分支，而正如我们刚看到的，阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔等人却难以把分析扩展到价格机制这一狭窄主题之外。正是在十九世纪末和二十世纪初的德国，马克斯·韦伯等领军学者坚持把经济与社会作为相互关联的过程来研究。
也正是在那里，经济过程管理的现代观念得到最清晰的发展。德国政治的危机——包括该国在第一次世界大战中被北大西洋世界帝国强权击败，以及战败后社会主义革命的可能性——呼唤新的观念。
en: The shift appears to have occurred among the works of German writers before it appeared in English. This reflects perhaps the concern of German scholars to define their field of research as ‘social economy’ (

). While John Stuart Mill, echoing Jean-Baptiste Say, had situated political economy as a branch of this wider field, men like Alfred Marshall, as we just saw, struggled to expand their analysis beyond the narrow topic of the price mechanism. It was in Germany in the late nineteenth and early twentieth century that leading scholars such as Max Weber insisted on studying economy and society as connected processes.

It was there that modern conceptions of the management of economic processes were most clearly developed. The crises of German politics, including the country’s defeat in the First World War by the imperial powers of the North Atlantic world, and the possibility of socialist revolution in the wake of that defeat, called for new conceptions.

zh: 英美思想接受这些观念较慢，它们往往通过翻译德国和奥地利社会理论家的著作进入英语。把关键的德语术语译成英语的困难，从
（经济）一词开始，有助于说明这些挑战。我们可以通过详细考察社会经济学家马克斯·韦伯的案例来结束本章。他的代表作
1922 年以德文出版，二十五年后英译本问世时被
误译了。
这些误译揭示了一些东西。问题始于书名中的两个词。在第二次世界大战后的时期，即英译本终于问世之时，经济与社会正逐渐被理解为自身存在的对象，各自形成一个由可识别、可衡量的关系构成的稳定领域。另一方面，正如基思·特赖布在其具有里程碑意义的文本重译中所指出的，韦伯仍然较少关注结构，更多关注过程。就社会一词而言，他关注的不是书名中使用的
，而是形成社会和其他联合体的过程，即
，字面意思是“社会化”。
但另一个术语“经济”呢？鉴于这个词到二十世纪中叶将在英语中获得的新含义的分量，要避免后来经济作为对象的含义来进行翻译就更加困难。在韦伯文本中阐述理解经济生活范畴的
第二章
里，他明确指出该词指一个过程：“在实践中，经济［
］意味着在目的之间仔细选择”，同时考虑可得手段的稀缺性。
在同一章开头的概念正式定义中，他通过用该词自己的动名词来界定自己的用法，确认了这一含义：他写道，经济应指“
”——字面意思是经济化。后者指对资源“和平行使处置权”，这种权力“有计划地”（理性地）指向经济目的。
en: Anglo-American thought was slower to adopt these ideas, which often arrived in English through the translation of the work of German and Austrian social theorists. The difficulty in translating key German terms into English, starting with the word
, or economy, helps illuminate these challenges. We can close this chapter by looking in detail at the case of the social economist Max Weber. His masterwork,
, published in German in 1922, was
mistranslated when it appeared in English twenty-five years later.

The mistranslations reveal something. The problem begins with the two words of the book’s title. In the period after the Second World War, when the English version finally appeared, economy and society were coming to be understood as objects in themselves, each forming a stable domain composed of relations that can be identified and measured. Weber, on the other hand, as Keith Tribe points out in his landmark retranslation of the text, was still interested less in structures than in processes. For the term society, he focused not on the word used in the title,
, but on the process of forming society – and other associations – or
, meaning literally ‘societisation’.

But what about the other term, ‘economy’? Given the weight of the new meaning the word was to acquire in English by the mid-twentieth century, it is more difficult to translate in a way that avoids the later sense of economy as an object. In
chapter 2
of his text, where he lays out the categories for understanding economic life, Weber makes clear that the term refers to a process: ‘in practice economy [
] means the careful choice between ends’, taking into account the scarcity of available means.
In the formal definition of the concept with which the same chapter opens, he confirms this meaning by defining his use of the word in terms of its own verbal noun: economy, he writes, shall mean ‘
’ – literally, economising. The latter term refers to ‘a peaceful exercise of a power of disposition’ over resources, a power that is ‘planfully’ (rationally) oriented to economic ends.

zh: 正如我们所见，“经济化”（economising）一词需要在一种不寻常的意义上使用，才能捕捉
的含义。在韦伯时代，英语经济一词被用来表示资源的有效处置，而 economising 通常传达更狭窄的节俭行事含义。这个词已失去其更广泛的意义，即指使某些商品或行动成为经济的那些过程和推理。威廉·斯马特在世纪之交前后把一些关键德文文本译成英文，他在翻译奥地利经济学派领军人物欧根·冯·庞巴维克的
时，试图在这一更广泛意义上使用该词：
en: As we have seen, the word ‘economising’ needs to be used in an unusual sense to capture the meaning of

. While the English term economy was used in Weber’s time to indicate the efficient disposition of resources, economising usually conveyed the narrower idea of acting with frugality. The word had lost its wider meaning referring to the processes and reasonings that render certain goods or actions economic. William Smart, who translated key texts from German into English around the turn of the century, tried using the term in this broader sense in translating
by Eugen von Bohm-Bawerk, a leading member of the Austrian school of economics:

zh: 在作为人类生产组合基础的大量自然禀赋中，有一部分特别引起经济学的兴趣，那就是自然仅以
有限数量提供的那些有用之物……自然世界的这些有限赠予和能量，对我们具有一种特殊的
重要性。不节约它们将是愚蠢的。
en: Of the vast natural endowment which serves as foundation for man’s productive combinations, one portion particularly claims the interest of economics, and that is, those useful things offered by nature only in
limited amount . . . These limited gifts and energies of the natural world obtain for us a peculiar
importance. It would be foolish not to economise them.

zh: 然而，即使在当时，更不用说今天，“economising”一词也使人想到节俭或吝啬，而不是使事物成为经济的。
en: However, even then, and more so today, ‘economising’ suggests thrift or parsimony, rather than rendering things economic.

zh: 绕过这一困难的一条途径，或许是把
译为“经济化”（economisation）；正如上文所指出的，米歇尔·卡隆用这个术语指把特定安排和行动定性为经济的过程，经济行动者和理论家都参与其中。用当代词汇来说，这一含义似乎呼应了韦伯方法的某些方面。
在 economisation（经济化）的意义上，economising 一词把韦伯与奥地利经济学派联系起来，正如我们将看到的，他与该学派关系密切。
这种联系使我们能够理解，韦伯的著作如何反常地促成了后来把经济理解为经济化的观念消失，并促使其转变为作为对象的“
经济整体”（the economy）。
en: One route around the difficulty might be to translate

as ‘economisation’, the term, as noted above, that Michel Callon proposes for the process of qualifying specific arrangements and actions as economic, in which both economic agents and theorists engage. Using a contemporary vocabulary, this meaning seems to echo aspects of Weber’s approach.
In the sense of economisation, the term ‘economising’ connects Weber to the Austrian school of economics, with which, as we will see, he was closely associated.
The connection allows us to understand how Weber’s work contributed, perversely, to the future disappearance of the understanding of economy as economising and its transformation into
economy as an object.

zh: 对韦伯以及十九世纪和二十世纪初的其他作家来说，经济过程可以在不同尺度上被识别。它并不以“
经济”为前提；国家尺度只是在把“经济”变成一个独立对象的过程中才成为默认尺度。
人们可以指家庭经济、村庄经济、城市经济和国民经济（
）的过程。
韦伯的同时代人把这种尺度差异理解为从较简单形式到较复杂形式的历史进步。然而在
中，韦伯对写作发展论叙述不感兴趣。他的目标是为理解当下澄清概念。
en: For Weber, as for other writers of the nineteenth and early twentieth century, the process of economy could be identified at different scales. It did not presuppose ‘
economy’, which became the default scale only as part of the way in which ‘economy’ was made into an object in itself.
One could refer to the processes of household economy, village economy, urban economy, and national economy (
Contemporaries of Weber read this difference in scale as a historical progression, from simpler to more complex forms. In
, however, Weber was not interested in writing a developmentalist account. His goal was to clarify concepts for understanding the present.

zh: 就我们的目的而言，在把经济化与资本化联系起来时，有趣的一点不是韦伯像其同时代人一样把经济理解为一个过程——经济化——而是他在定义这个词时，设定了两种经济化之间的区分。这一区分指向对商业或商业企业问题及其在资本化中作用的理解。韦伯引入这一区分，正是为了确立经济的定义：“‘Wirtschaft’ soll ein autokephal, ‘Wirtschaftsbetrieb’ ein betriebsmäßig geordnetes kontinuierliches Wirtschaften heißen.
（“经济”应指一种自主的经济化，“企业经济”应指一种按企业经营方式有序组织的持续经济化。）”
en: The interesting point for our purpose, in connecting economisation to capitalisation, is not that Weber, like his contemporaries, understands economy as a process – economisation – but that, in defining the term, he sets up a distinction between two kinds of economising. The distinction points towards understanding the problem of business or business enterprise and its role in capitalisation. Weber introduces the distinction to establish the very definition of economy: ‘“Wirtschaft” soll ein autokephal, “Wirtschaftsbetrieb” ein betriebsmäßig geordnetes kontinuierliches Wirtschaften heißen.
(“Economy” shall mean an autocephalous, “enterprise-economy” a continuously ordered economising.)’

zh: 韦伯不是孤立地定义经济，而是通过
（经济）与
（字面意思是企业经济）之间的对比来定义。他说，第一个术语应指“自主的”（自我治理的）经济化，第二个则应指企业规模的“持续有序”的经济化。
en: Weber defines economy not in isolation, but via a contrast between
(economy) and

– literally, enterpriseeconomy. The first term, he says, shall mean an ‘autocephalous’ (self-governing) economisation, whereas the second shall mean an enterprise-scale ‘continuously ordered’ economising.

zh: 用于构成复合词
的
一词，可以译为“企业”。

因此，这一措辞可能暗示自主经济（例如以家庭为基础的经济化）与企业经济之间的区分。然而，这里的“企业”具有误导性，因为它通常指一个离散的经营单位——单个公司或工厂。韦伯明确指出，他的意思指的不是一个单位，而再次是一个过程。事实上，这种更大尺度上经济化的目的，恰恰在于它是一种计算活动——正如我们将看到的——使彼此分离的经济单位和过程得以连接起来。它使跨产品、地点、或关键的时间周期差异来安排和处置经营活动成为可能。这种可计算性使自主形式的经济生活得以转化为一个持久、相互关联、持续有序的过程的组成部分。
en: The term
, used to form the compound word
, can be translated as ‘enterprise’.

So the wording might suggest the distinction between autocephalous economy, such as household-based economisation, and enterprise-based economy. However, ‘enterprise’ here is misleading, as it usually designates a discrete business unit – an individual firm or factory. Weber makes clear that his meaning refers not to a unit but, once again, to a process. In fact, the purpose of economisation at this larger scale is precisely that it is the calculative activity, as we will see, that allows separate economic units and processes to be connected. It enables the arranging and disposing of operations across differences in product, location, or, critically, period of time. Such calculability allows the transformation of self-governing forms of economic life into parts of an enduring, interconnected, continuously ordered process.

zh: 因此，经济化采取两种形式：不连续的（或自主的）与持续相互关联的。为什么用不连续与“持续有序”之间的差异、而不是家庭与企业之间的差异来定义经济概念本身？原因是，对韦伯来说，耐久性和连续性——在空间和
两个维度上的延伸——是由一种特定计算形式的经济化力量促成的，这种计算既可复制，又能不断自我复制。该书对当时资本主义生活的解释就建立在这一差异之上。这种解释把资本化所依赖的
形式置于经济化的中心。
en: Economisation, then, takes two forms, discontinuous (or autonomous) versus continuously interconnected. Why define the very concept of economy in terms of the difference not between household and business enterprise, but between the discontinuous and the ‘continuously ordered’? The reason is that, for Weber, durability and continuity – extension in both space and

– are made possible by the economising power of a specific form of calculation, one that is both replicable and continuously replicating. The text’s explanation of contemporary capitalist life rests on this difference. It is an explanation that places at the centre of economisation the forms of
on which capitalisation depends.

zh: 韦伯区分了两种经济计算形式：实物核算和货币核算。
简言之，实物核算（
）比较性质相似但在数量或产出上不同的材料或过程。另一方面，货币核算指一种计算形式，其中完全不同的过程或材料可以通过用共同的记账单位（通常是货币单位）来表示而变得可比。
en: Weber distinguishes between two forms of economic calculation, accounting in kind and accounting in money.
Put simply, accounting in kind, or

, compares materials or processes that are similar in nature, but differ in quantity or in output. Accounting in money, on the other hand, refers to a form of calculation in which entirely different processes or materials can be made comparable, by expressing all of them in a common unit of account, typically a monetary unit.

zh: 两种核算形式之间的区分与资本化未来直接相关。任何规模的企业都可以采用
核算，通过以其他物品或过程来估算某一物品或过程的成本，从而计算某一过程的成本或盈利能力。例如，
一台特定类型的机器可以使用能源、劳动和材料的不同组合来生产某种产品。然而，正如韦伯所解释的，要用
估价来扩大和复制这种计算，很快就会变得笨重难行。如果企业多元化生产另一种产品，就难以跨不同生产过程计算成本和收入；如果它考虑在第二个地点增加一项业务，或希望把当前成本与稍后某一时刻的成本相比较，

children: 以便对未来收入进行贴现

zh: ，那就更加困难。这种跨过程、地点、尤其是时间跨度差异的企业扩张，依赖于第二种计算形式，即货币核算。
en: The distinction between the two forms of accounting relates directly to capitalising the future. Any business at any scale can employ accounting
to calculate the costs or profitability of a process, by estimating the cost of one item or process in terms of others. For example,

a machine of a given type can produce a certain product using various combinations of energy, labour, and materials. However, as Weber explains, to scale up and replicate such calculations using evaluations

soon becomes unwieldy. If the firm diversifies into another kind of product, it becomes difficult to calculate cost and income across different production processes, and even more so if it considers adding an operation at a second location or wishes to compare present costs with those at a subsequent moment in time,

children: for the purpose of discounting future revenue

en: . Such business expansion across differences in process, location, and, above all, duration of time depends upon the second form of calculation, money accounting.

zh: 在把“货币核算”描述为两种经济化模式之一的基础时，韦伯关心的不只是计算盈利能力的某种特定技术，例如复式记账（尽管那可能起作用）。相反，他是在阐述经济化在建造一个持久、面向未来、大规模企业世界中所发挥的具体作用：把差异转化为单一的比较标准，其基础是作为记账单位的货币。换言之，这种经济化是资本化扩张所必需的。这种转化不一定需要实际使用货币支付或市场交易。货币价格可以用来创造交换过程的“虚构”，或确定未来获利的机会。

事实上，它们的主要用处可能在企业内部：企业扩张和跨时间“持续”经济化的机会，包括对未来成本的预测，都依赖于货币核算的使用。当然，这种核算也会延伸到企业之外的交易，并可以为关于是在内部还是从外部供应商获得某种产品或服务的决策提供依据。这种与其他企业或消费者的商业互动，确立并推广了货币核算过程。虽然经济化主要在企业内部组织，但如果没有商业交换的可能性，企业活动的扩张和协调就会失败。这个不断扩展的可计算性网络——其核心是货币核算所促成的未来可计算性——正是韦伯区分“持续有序”的经济化与单纯的自主“经济”时所想到的东西。
en: In describing ‘accounting in money’ as the basis of one of the two modes of economisation, Weber is not concerned simply with a particular technique for calculating profitability, such as double-entry bookkeeping (although that may play a part). Rather, he is laying out the specific role that economisation plays in building a world of durable, future-oriented, large-scale enterprise: the conversion of difference into a single standard of comparison, based on money as a unit of account. In other words, economisation of this kind is required for the expansion of capitalisation. The conversion does not necessarily require the actual use of monetary payments, or market transactions. The money prices can be deployed to create ‘the fiction’ of exchange processes or to determine the opportunities for future gain.

In fact, their main usefulness may lie within the firm, whose opportunities for expansion and for ‘continuous’ economisation across time, including the projection of future costs, rest on the use of money accounting. Of course, such accounting will also extend to transactions outside the business and can inform decisions about whether to obtain a certain product or service in-house or from an outside vendor. Such commercial interaction with other firms, or with consumers, establishes and generalises the process of monetary accounting. Although economisation is largely organised within business enterprise, without the possibility of commercial exchange the expansion and coordination of business activity would fail. This expanding network of calculability, and centrally the calculability of the future, made possible by money accounting, is what Weber has in mind in distinguishing ‘continuously ordered’ economisation from mere self-governing (autocephalous) ‘economy’.

zh: 没有经济计算就没有经济
en: Without Economic Calculation There Is No Economy

zh: 为什么韦伯把这种核算过程、而不是市场扩张、劳动剥削、垄断权力的扩散或他叙述中同样出现的其他历史发展，置于其对当时资本主义经济化理解的中心？结果发现，韦伯对核算的兴趣并非源于理解资本主义历史发展的关切，而是源于某种更紧迫之事：资本主义即将灭亡的可能性。
en: Why does Weber place at the centre of his understanding of contemporary capitalist economisation this process of accounting – rather than, say, the expansion of markets, the exploitation of labour, the spread of monopoly power, or other historical developments that also figure in his account? Weber’s interest in accounting, it turns out, arises not from a concern with understanding the historical development of capitalism, but from something more urgent: the imminent possibility of its demise.

zh: 在韦伯写作此书时，社会党正在俄罗斯、德国、巴伐利亚共和国、奥地利和欧洲其他地区掌权或威胁掌权。在韦伯看来，国家或共同体接管工业和金融的所有权与管理，其问题不仅在于取消产权、废除市场或消除竞争。问题在于瓦解以货币核算为基础的协调机制，即允许扩展的、持续的、不断扩张的经济化——因而也是资本化——的计算原则。在社会主义“计划经济”下，关于资源的集中决策取代了商业交换，经济化过程无法产生一套价格。这种价格可能来自交换，但也可能来自卡特尔安排、劳动协议、企业内部核算或其他来源。消失的不只是“市场”，而是整个“有效”价格的过程——无论它们如何产生——大企业正是通过这一过程配置资源、持续扩张并计算和贴现未来收入。
en: As Weber was writing his text, socialist parties were coming to power, or threatening to do so, in Russia, Germany, the Bavarian Republic, Austria, and other parts of Europe. As Weber saw it, the problem with the state or community taking over the ownership and management of industry and finance lay not simply in the elimination of property rights, the abolition of markets, or the removal of competition. It lay in undoing the coordination mechanism based on money accounting, the principle of calculation that allows extended, continuous, and expanding economisation – and thus capitalisation. Under socialist ‘planned economy’, where centralised decisions about resources replace commercial exchange, the process of economisation fails to generate a set of prices. Such prices may arise from exchange, but also from cartel arrangements, labour agreements, internal business accounting, or other sources. What disappears is not simply ‘the market’, but the entire process of ‘effective’ prices, however they arise, through which large enterprises allocate resources, continuously expand, and calculate and discount future revenue.

zh: 韦伯发展

计算与货币核算之间的区分，不仅是为了理解资本主义的生活形式，而且是为了论证大规模“计划经济”在技术上的不可能性。结果，该书的大部分内容归结为仅仅两种经济化模式之间的对比：“计划经济”与“货币经济”。在作出这一对比时，经济一词开始失去其与计算方法的联系——计算方法可以发生在多个尺度上——并似乎指把经济过程的整体作为自身对象来把握的一种方式。为了证明社会主义项目的不可能性——该项目旨在把经济化作为一个整体来治理——韦伯无意中促成了把这一整体当作一个对象来思考的可能性。
en: Weber develops the distinction between calculation

and money accounting not just to understand capitalist forms of life, but to argue for the technical impossibility of large-scale ‘planned economy’. As a result, much of the text resolves into a contrast between just two modes of economisation, ‘planned economy’ and ‘money economy’. In making this contrast, the term economy begins to lose its association with calculative methods, which can occur at multiple scales, and appears to designate a way of grasping the totality of economic processes as an object in itself. To demonstrate the impossibility of the socialist project, which aims to govern economisation as a whole, Weber has inadvertently contributed to the possibility of thinking of that whole as an object.

zh: 因此，韦伯偏爱研究过程而不是结构，可以看作不仅是方法论上的选择。它记录了其写作所处的政治
语境。中央经济计划提出了如何把握经济生活之整体的问题，这既是经济计划者的问题，因而也是社会经济解释的问题。韦伯的答案是，它只能作为一个分散但相互关联的过程的结果来把握。然而，在韦伯著作之后的岁月里，由于一种根本不同的集体生活治理方式即社会主义的出现，计划经济和货币经济将被解读为治理共同对象的两种模式：“
经济整体”（the economy）。
en: Thus, Weber’s preference for the study of processes rather than structures can be seen as not merely methodological. It registers the political

context in which he is writing. Central economic planning presents the problem of how the entirety of economic life can be grasped, both by economic planners and, as a consequence, by social-economic explanation. Weber’s answer is that it can be grasped only as the outcome of a dispersed, but interconnected, process. However, in the years after Weber’s work, thanks to the appearance of a fundamentally different mode of governing collective life, in socialism, planned economy and money economy will come to be read as two modes of governing a common object:
economy.

zh: 韦伯今天被认为是二十世纪或许最有影响的经济生活社会理论家。但他的影响并非来自他关于经济的著作，而是来自他反对这一观念的努力。他于 1920 年 6 月去世。与此同时，在战后的维也纳，一群被称为米塞斯圈子的知识分子——他们与韦伯有联系并受其影响——已经开始发展关于经济计算的类似论点。这些论点后来成为被称为新自由主义的智识运动的核心（我们将在
讨论这一运动后来的重要性）。
路德维希·冯·米塞斯的文章《社会主义共同体中的经济计算》（1920）在韦伯自己的著作仍在校对时引起了他的注意。韦伯此后不久去世，当时他的出版商正在排版
的第一部分。该书的其他部分后来根据韦伯较早著作的草稿汇编而成，形成一部笨重、不连贯、艰深的巨著。然而，由于米塞斯圈子，这本书从相对默默无闻中被抢救出来，最终得以出版英译本。这项抢救工作始于十五年之后，是当时以英语世界为中心、反对“
经济整体”（the economy）作为对象出现的新一轮努力的一部分。
en: Weber is known today as perhaps the most influential twentieth-century social theorist of economic life. But he owes his influence not to his writings on the economy, but to his efforts to oppose the idea. He died in June 1920. Meanwhile, in postwar Vienna, the group of intellectuals known as the Mises Circle, who were associated with and influenced by Weber, had begun developing similar arguments about economic calculation. The arguments were to become the core of the intellectual movement later named neoliberalism (a movement to whose later significance we will turn in

An essay by Ludwig von Mises, ‘Economic Calculation in the Socialist Commonwealth’ (1920), came to Weber’s attention while his own work was in proof. Weber died shortly thereafter, just as his publisher was typesetting part one of

. The other parts of the book were assembled later from drafts of Weber’s earlier writings, creating an unwieldy, disconnected, and difficult tome. Thanks to the Mises Circle, however, the book was rescued from relative obscurity and eventually made available in English. Begun a decade and a half later, the rescuing was part of a renewed effort, now centred in the English-speaking world, to oppose the emergence of
economy as an object.

zh: 1935 年，米塞斯圈子成员、新兴新自由主义运动的关键人物弗里德里希·哈耶克出版了米塞斯那篇关于经济计算文章的英文译本。他将其收入一本旨在提醒英语读者注意反对经济计划可行性的论点的文集，此时这种计划即使在英国和美国也正成为一种威胁。
在该书导言中，哈耶克把韦伯与米塞斯并列为最早发展这一论点的人。
en: In 1935, Friedrich Hayek, a member of the Mises Circle and lynchpin of the emerging neoliberal movement, published an English translation of the Mises essay on economic calculation. He included it in a collection intended to alert English readers to the argument against the feasibility of economic planning, which was now emerging as a threat even in Britain and the United States.
In his introduction to the book, Hayek names Weber alongside Mises as those who had first developed this argument.

zh: 然而，哈耶克本人不再以旧方式使用“经济”一词。对米塞斯和对韦伯来说一样，经济是一个计算过程。事实上，对米塞斯而言，社会主义下货币核算的消除标志着经济本身的缺席：“Ohne Wirtschaftsrechnung keine
Wirtschaft”，他写道（没有经济计算就没有经济）。
十五年后，哈耶克在新的政治语境中向英语读者介绍这篇文章时，颠倒了这个词的用法。
en: Hayek himself, however, no longer used ‘economy’ in the old way. For Mises, as for Weber, economy was a process of calculation. Indeed, the elimination of money accounting under socialism signalled for Mises the very absence of economy: ‘Ohne Wirtschaftsrechnung keine
Wirtschaft’, he wrote (without economic calculation there is no economy).
Introducing this essay to English readers fifteen years later, in a new political context, Hayek reverses the use of the word.

zh: 在总结反对计划的论点时，他只是把“经济”用作贬义词，指当时作为两次世界大战之间危机四伏的资本主义替代方案而出现的凯恩斯主义或新政方案。他在“计划经济”“中央指导的经济”或干脆“社会主义经济”等短语中使用这个词。为了描述其对立面，即一种由个人或企业自利计算支配的生活方式，他一次也没有使用经济一词，而宁愿使用“自由社会的制度”“基于交换的体系”或“纯粹竞争的社会”等短语。
四十年后，哈耶克仍反对使用“经济”一词，转而提出“交换秩序”（catallaxy）一词（经由米塞斯从上面提到的理查德·惠特利 1831 年牛津讲座中借用）。
然而到那时，正如我们将在
看到的，哈耶克的追随者正用更简单的抽象取代“自由社会的制度”等短语，这一抽象后来作为经济观念的替代品被广泛采用：“市场”。然而，即使在 1930 年代，对哈耶克来说，“经济”如今所指的整体也只是集中计划的不可能对象，是“资本主义社会”的对立面。
en: In summarising the argument against planning, he uses ‘economy’ only as a negative term, to designate what was now emerging as a Keynesian or New Deal alternative to the crisis-ridden capitalism of the interwar period. He employs the word in phrases such as ‘a planned economy’, ‘a centrally directed economy’, or simply ‘a socialist economy’. To describe its opposite, a mode of life governed by the calculation of individual or corporate self-interest, he never once uses the term economy, preferring phrases such as ‘the institutions of a free society’, ‘a system based on exchange’, or a ‘purely competitive society’.

Four decades later, Hayek was still objecting to the use of the term ‘economy’, proposing instead the word ‘catallaxy’ (borrowed – through Mises – from Richard Whately’s Oxford lectures of 1831, mentioned above).
By then, however, as we will see in

, Hayek’s followers were replacing phrases like ‘the institutions of a free society’ with a simpler abstraction, later to be widely adopted as an alternative to the idea of the economy: ‘the market’. Even in the 1930s, however, for Hayek the totality to which ‘the economy’ now referred designated only the impossible object of centralised planning, the antithesis of ‘a capitalistic society’.

zh: 大约同一时期，正如特赖布告诉我们的，哈耶克帮助招募了一位年轻的苏格兰经济学家，开始把韦伯
的第一部分译成英文。这项翻译工作后来由美国社会学家塔尔科特·帕森斯（阿尔弗雷德·钱德勒的老师）接手并重新加工。
由于战争而推迟，译本直到 1947 年才问世。到那时，正如我们将在下一章看到的，经济已经成为一个对象，而且在帕森斯手中确实成为一个“系统”。韦伯对这个词的定义——“经济应指……经济化”——如今被相应改写为：帕森斯在其误译中让韦伯说，一个“经济
）是一个“经济行动的
“系统”一词在韦伯文本中从未出现。原文也不含不定冠词 an（“一个”），而英文译本中的这个冠词起着把作为过程的经济转化为作为对象的经济的作用。二十年后，韦伯文本的修订英译本出版。这个版本删去了“系统”一词，但保留了不定冠词。
到 1960 年代，“一个经济”这一概念本身已经指帕森斯试图指认的结构性系统。
en: Around the same time, as Tribe tells us, Hayek helped recruit a young Scottish economist to start translating part one of Weber’s
into English. The translation was taken over and reworked by the American sociologist Talcott Parsons (the teacher of Alfred Chandler).

Delayed by the war, it appeared only in 1947. By then, as we will see in the next chapter, economy had become an object, and indeed in the hands of Parsons, ‘a system’. Weber’s definition of the term – ‘economy shall mean . . . economisation’ – was now rewritten accordingly: ‘An “economic
)’, Parsons makes Weber say in his mistranslation of the text, is a ‘
of economic action’.

The word ‘system’ occurs nowhere in Weber’s text. Nor does the original contain the indefinite article ‘an’, which in the English translation operates to transform economy as process into economy as an object. Twenty years later, a revised English translation of Weber’s text was published. This version removed the word ‘system’, while retaining the indefinite article.
By the 1960s the concept of ‘an economy’ signified by itself the structural system that Parsons had tried to identify.

zh: 基思·特赖布对
的重译，使我们能够把书名中的两个关键术语读作社会化和经济化：也就是说，读作
过程，而不是对象。但它也使我们能够在文本本身中读出，韦伯对其时代政治的紧迫智识回应，如何促成了那些使经济不再被理解为经济化的发展。
en: Keith Tribe’s retranslation of
allows us to read the two key terms of its title as sociation and economisation: that is, as

processes, not objects. But it also allows us to read, in the text itself, the way Weber’s urgent intellectual response to the politics of his times contributed to the developments through which economy would no longer be understood as economisation.

zh: 关注韦伯对经济一词的使用，使我们能够恢复“这个经济整体”（the economy）被发明之前思考经济的一种方式。这不仅是一个历史兴趣问题。在过去二十年里，一些关于如何思考经济的最重要著作建议我们用经济化概念取代经济一词。这个概念可以用来指使过程和材料成为经济的安排、计算、定性和推理。
这个术语使我们认识到，“这个经济整体”不是人类社会生活的普遍领域，而是特定计算、装置和行动的产物。这引起人们对本章所探讨问题的注意，而这个问题被我们日常使用经济一词所掩盖：为了资本化过程，必须持续进行学术和实践工作，使事物成为经济的；这种工作总是不完整的，并容易受到扰乱。
en: Paying attention to Weber’s use of the term economy enables us to recover a way of thinking about economy before the invention of ‘the economy’. This is not only a matter of historical interest. Over the last two decades, some of the most important writing addressing how to think about the economic has proposed that we replace the term economy with the concept of economisation. The concept can be used to denote the arranging, calculating, qualifying, and reasoning through which processes and materials are rendered economic.

The term brings into view the realisation that ‘the economy’ is not a universal realm of human social life but the product of particular calculations, devices, and actions. This draws attention to the issue explored in this chapter, obscured by our everyday use of the word economy: the continuous academic and practical work that must be done, in service of the process of capitalisation, always incomplete and open to disruption, to render things economic.
